copy.returns: the end time in AudioContext seconds
copy.chains: one master chain per destination, kept on the context in ac.timbreChains

levels.about: Measured by gates/check_levels.mjs in dBFS after the master chain on a warm chain. peak and rms: at the defaults (the worst peak and the mean RMS of 3 seeds). worstPeak, worstRms and lowestPeak: over all 12 renders (the defaults and 3 random parameter sets, 3 seeds each). pre: the highest peak before the limiter over all renders. end: where the default render falls below -60 dBFS, in seconds.

families.soft: Muted, rounded and padded: sine blips, thocks, gentle swells and quiet chimes
families.glass: Bright, clear and ringing: glassy ticks, pings, crystal and glints
families.wood: Knocks, clacks and taps of wood, clay or bone: blocks, clocks, board pieces, chips, dice
families.metal: Struck and ringing metal: coins, keys, blades, hammers
families.mechanical: Switches, keys, latches, machines and hum
families.air: Whooshes, breaths, swishes, slides and wind
families.chip: 8-bit square and pulse voices: chiptune, arcade and retro computer beeps
families.synthetic: Electronic tones: buzzes, lasers, FM, sweeps, pads, drones and sci-fi machines
families.organic: Natural sources: water, fire, weather, birds, bubbles, footsteps, a bowstring
families.orchestral: Tuned and acoustic instruments: bells, plucks, mallets, harp, brass, bowed strings, organ and timpani
families.impact: Blows, thuds and booms: punches, heavy hits, landings and explosions
families.voice: Speech, talk and song: synthesized announcers and robots, whispers, character babble, choirs

roles.on: Switch: 1 plays the on direction (check, enable, switch on), 0 the off direction
roles.open: Switch: 1 plays opening (expand, show, slide in), 0 closing
roles.chip: Switch: 1 swaps in an 8-bit square-wave voicing, 0 keeps the softer voice
roles.go: Switch: 1 plays the longer, higher go cue that ends a countdown, 0 a count beat
roles.up: Switch: 1 plays the rising direction (increase, rise, evolve), 0 the falling one (decrease, fall, devolve)
roles.pass: Switch: 1 plays the pass verdict (allow, valid), 0 the block (deny, invalid)
roles.tick: Switch: 1 plays the recurring per-turn tick (a checkup, an upkeep), 0 the first application

moments.click: A button, link or control is pressed.
moments.hover: The pointer moves over or focuses a control.
moments.toggle-on: A switch, checkbox or setting is turned on.
moments.toggle-off: A switch, checkbox or setting is turned off.
moments.type: A key is pressed while typing.
moments.open: A menu, panel, modal or drawer opens or slides in.
moments.close: A menu, panel, modal or drawer closes.
moments.transition: A screen, page or scene changes; something sweeps past.
moments.scroll: A scroll wheel, picker or slider passes a notch.
moments.drag: An item is picked up to be dragged.
moments.drop: A dragged item lands on its target.
moments.tooltip: A tooltip, hint or popover appears.
moments.copy: Something is copied to the clipboard.
moments.undo: An action is undone or reverted.
moments.delete: Something is removed, trashed or cleared.
moments.send: A message or form is sent, submitted or published.
moments.select: The selection moves to another tab, segment, pill or option. A sound for it may take a pos parameter (0 to 1): where the selection lands.
moments.step: A stepper or wizard advances to its next step. A sound for it may take a step parameter: which step it reached.
moments.record: Recording starts or stops: a sound for it carries an on switch, 1 starts, 0 stops.
moments.reveal: Content is uncovered: a wipe, an iris, a shutter, a curtain.
moments.stamp: A rubber stamp lands: approved, paid, verified, a label slapped on.
moments.auth: A sign in or out, a lock or unlock: a sound for it carries an on switch, 1 signs in or unlocks, 0 signs out or locks.
moments.success: An action finished well: saved, sent, paid, completed.
moments.error: An action was rejected or failed: invalid input, denied, failed.
moments.warning: Something needs attention but did not fail.
moments.info: Neutral news: nothing wrong, nothing won.
moments.message: A message, chat or email arrives.
moments.reminder: A calendar event, reminder or due date comes up.
moments.timer: A timer, countdown or alarm ends.
moments.achievement: A milestone, badge or reward is earned.
moments.dismiss: A notification, toast or chip is dismissed or swiped away.
moments.critical: A critical alert, a severity above error: an incident, a breach, an outage.
moments.presence: Someone comes online or goes offline: a sound for it carries an on switch, 1 online, 0 offline.
moments.purchase: A payment or purchase completes: a cash register, a checkout, a tip.
moments.loading: Something loads or waits with no known end: a spinner, dots, a skeleton. A sound for it is a loop cell (tag loop-cell), re-triggered on an interval while the wait lasts.
moments.progress: A determinate step of progress: a bar or ring advances. A sound for it may take a pos parameter (0 to 1) and be played on each update.
moments.load-complete: A wait resolves: a spinner turns into a check, a skeleton into content.
moments.data-tick: A counter, odometer or ticker steps by one value.
moments.count-up: A number rolls up to its value: a KPI, a total, an odometer run.
moments.chart-reveal: A chart draws in: bars rise, a line traces, areas fill.
moments.threshold: A meter or gauge crosses into amber or red, or back: a limit, an SLO, a quota.
moments.sort: Rows or items reorder: a table sorts, a leaderboard swaps places.
moments.beacon: One beacon or sonar pulse: you are here, an accuracy ring, an outage ripple.
moments.pin-drop: A map pin or marker drops onto its spot.
moments.route: A dot or vehicle travels a route on a map, hop by hop to its arrival.
moments.packet: A packet hops along a wire or link between nodes in a diagram.
moments.link: A connection is made or dropped: a socket, a peering, a VPN. A sound for it carries an on switch, 1 connects, 0 disconnects.
moments.failover: The active node fails and a standby takes over.
moments.scale: Capacity scales out or in: servers added or removed, a cluster grows or shrinks. A sound for it carries an up switch, 1 scales out, 0 scales in.
moments.thinking: An AI or agent is working or thinking. A sound for it is a loop cell (tag loop-cell), re-triggered on an interval while it works.
moments.stream-token: Machine text streams in token by token (not a person typing).
moments.tool-call: An agent calls a tool or function and the result comes back.
moments.verdict: A check passes or blocks: a guardrail, a field validation, a review. A sound for it carries a pass switch, 1 allows, 0 blocks.
moments.hit: A blow lands: a hit, impact or strike.
moments.pickup: An item is picked up or collected.
moments.coin: A coin, currency or small reward is gained or spun.
moments.level-up: The player levels up or unlocks something big.
moments.power-up: A power-up, boost or buff is collected.
moments.victory: The player wins a round or finishes a level.
moments.game-over: The player loses or the run ends.
moments.footstep: A footstep while walking or running.
moments.shoot: A weapon fires: a laser, blaster, arrow or shot.
moments.countdown: A countdown beat before a round starts.
moments.level-down: A demotion, the mirror of level-up: a rank drops, a streak is lost, a level is taken away.
moments.card-draw: A card is drawn, dealt or flicked.
moments.card-flip: A card is turned face up.
moments.shuffle: A deck is shuffled or riffled.
moments.your-turn: Control passes to you in a turn-based game or a shared session: your move.
moments.card-tap: A card turns sideways to act or pay (tap, exert) or stands up again: a sound for it carries an on switch, 1 taps, 0 untaps or readies.
moments.resource: A resource is added: mana, ink, an energy attached.
moments.score: Points are scored: lore, prizes, victory points.
moments.ability: A creature or card ability activates: a triggered, passive or once per turn power.
moments.debuff: A status condition or debuff lands (poison, burn, sleep, paralysis, confusion) or ticks at the turn checkup: a sound for it may carry a tick switch, 0 the application, 1 the recurring tick.
moments.crit: A critical or super effective hit: a weakness doubles the damage.
moments.knockout: A creature or character is knocked out: heavier than a hit, the end of one fighter.
moments.sparkle: A magical twinkle: a bonus, a reveal.
moments.power-down: A machine, shield or system powers down.
moments.door: A door, hatch or chest opens or latches.
moments.shield: A shield or force field goes up or takes a hit.
moments.readout: A console or HUD prints a readout or acknowledges.
moments.scan: A scanner, radar or sensor sweeps.
moments.chips: Poker chips are clicked, stacked or pushed.
moments.tension: Suspense under a scene: a pulse, a slow rise or a held breath before something happens.
moments.scare: A sting for a scare, a twist or a mystery.
moments.transform: Something morphs, evolves or devolves: a sound for it carries an up switch, 1 evolves or grows, 0 devolves or shrinks.
moments.glitch: A digital glitch or corruption burst: an RGB split, a datamosh, a VHS tear.
moments.neon-on: A neon tube or a bad bulb strikes, flickers and settles into its hum.
moments.type-out: Text types or decodes onto the screen: a typewriter line and its carriage return, a teletype, a scramble that resolves into words.
moments.announce: A voice announces something: an alert, a status, a result.
moments.dialogue: A character talks: babble under a text box or a speech bubble.
moments.ambience: A bed of sound under a scene.
moments.music: A short musical phrase, sting or jingle.

sounds.name: Stagger Cascade
sounds.desc: A quick roll of soft pops climbing in pitch from left to right, the last one ringing slightly. For staggered lists, chips and words appearing one by one.

gap.desc: Time between pops: short a tight roll, long a stepped cascade

pitch.desc: Note of the first pop; the rest climb from it

fan.desc: How far the pops fan upward: 0 every pop on one note, 1 about two octaves

sounds.name: Checkbox
sounds.desc: A bright two-note pluck when a box is checked and a short muted drop when it is cleared.

on.desc: 1 plays the rising two-note check, 0 the single muted falling uncheck

pitch.desc: Base note: the check rises a fifth above it, the uncheck falls from that fifth

bright.desc: Check sparkle: 0 pure notes, 1 octave overtones and a crisper tick; uncheck ignores it

sounds.name: Crisp Click
sounds.desc: A dry, snappy click for primary buttons: a bandpassed noise transient over a stiff triangle tick, gone in 30 ms.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the click: sets the noise snap band and the triangle tick under it

snap.desc: Loudness of the noise transient: 0 a subdued tick, 1 a sharp crack

body.desc: Level of the low triangle tick under the snap: 0 thin, 1 fuller

sounds.name: Deep Click
sounds.desc: A low, padded thock for heavy buttons and primary actions: a falling sine body with a soft knock on top.

pitch.desc: How low the thock sits; its octave overtone follows

click.desc: Level of the noise knock on top: 0 mostly a padded thump, 1 a pronounced knock

length.desc: Decay of the sine body and overtone: 0 a tight thud, 1 a longer falling thock

sounds.name: Glass Click
sounds.desc: A bright, glassy tick for buttons: a few high inharmonic partials with a short ring, light and clean.

pitch.desc: Base frequency of the glassy partials

ring.desc: Decay of the glass tone: 0 a short tick, 1 a longer ring

bright.desc: Top partial and air tick level: 0 rounder, 1 sparkly with more air

sounds.name: Soft Click
sounds.desc: A short muted tick for button presses: a falling sine blip with a breath of high noise.

pitch.desc: Start note of the falling sine blip

tone.desc: Brightness and level of the high noise breath: 0 muted, 1 crisp and airy

sounds.name: Wooden Click
sounds.desc: A warm wooden knock for buttons: a short damped block tone with a dull knuckle thud, calm enough to repeat all day.

pitch.desc: Note of the block tone, which droops slightly as it rings

ring.desc: Decay of the block tone: 0 a dead knock, 1 a short resonant ring

hollow.desc: Level of the inharmonic overtone: 0 solid and dull, 1 hollow like a woodblock

sounds.name: Copy to Clipboard
sounds.desc: A quick rising scoop and a bright ping to confirm a copy to the clipboard.

pitch.desc: Note of the confirming bell ping

scoop.desc: Loudness of the rising noise scoop that leads into the ping

ring.desc: Decay of the ping: 0 a short blip, 1 a longer ring

sounds.name: Delete to Trash
sounds.desc: A short paper crumple that drops into a bin with a dull thud, for deleting or discarding an item.

crunch.desc: How many paper crackles play before the thud; more makes a longer crumple

pitch.desc: Tuning of the landing thud

weight.desc: Loudness of the landing thud and its knock, light to heavy

sounds.name: Drag Drop
sounds.desc: A soft landing thud for dropping an item on its target, with an optional small bounce as it settles.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the landing thud and its bounce

bounce.desc: Level of the small second bounce: 0 none, 1 a clear settle

snap.desc: Level of the noise knock on impact: 0 soft and padded, 1 a sharper knock

sounds.name: Drag Pickup
sounds.desc: A soft lift for grabbing an item to drag: a small grip tick and a short rising breath.

pitch.desc: Start note of the rising triangle tone

lift.desc: How far the breath and tone rise: 0 a small lift, 1 a wide upward sweep

air.desc: Loudness of the rising breath of noise

sounds.name: Drop Zone
sounds.desc: A drop zone for files: a soft rising breath when a file hovers over it, and a gulp, a low thunk and a small settle pip when it lands.

drop.desc: 1 plays the swallow and settle when the file lands, 0 the rising breath of a file held over the zone

depth.desc: How deep the zone swallows: 0 a shallow, higher thunk, 1 a deep, low one

air.desc: Level of the breath in the rise and the gulp: 0 faint, 1 clearly airy

sounds.name: Expand and Collapse
sounds.desc: A quick stepped run of soft blips: rising when a section expands, falling and a touch quieter when it collapses.

open.desc: 1 plays the rising expand run, 0 the falling, slightly quieter collapse run

steps.desc: Number of blips in the run

gap.desc: Time between blips: short for a quick flutter, long for a stepped run

pitch.desc: Lowest note of the run; the others climb the pentatonic above it

sounds.name: Submenu Flyout
sounds.desc: A short, bright puff and pip for a submenu or nested context menu opening beside its parent; closing falls and ends in a soft tick.

open.desc: 1 plays the rising puff and landing pip, 0 the falling close with a soft low tick

pitch.desc: Note of the landing pip for the first level

depth.desc: How many menus deep: each level lifts the sound a major third and shortens it

sounds.name: Focus Ring
sounds.desc: A soft pip with a few fading echoes for keyboard focus landing on a control, like a ring spreading outward.

pitch.desc: Note of the pip, which bends slightly upward

spread.desc: Time between echoes: short sounds tight, long spreads the ring outward

echo.desc: Level of the fading echoes against the dry pip: low mostly pip, high a clear ring

sounds.name: Hover Tick
sounds.desc: A barely-there high tick for the pointer entering a button or row. Very quiet, meant to repeat.

pitch.desc: Frequency of the tick, which dips slightly as it fades

air.desc: Level of the high noise hiss over the tone: 0 mostly pure, 1 breathier

sounds.name: Light Keypress
sounds.desc: A light, quiet keypress for typing: a soft thump and tap that varies a little each press; size reaches the spacebar.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the low thump, varied a little on each press

bright.desc: Tone of the tap on top: 0 dull and muted, 1 brighter and clickier

size.desc: Key size: 0 a letter key, 1 a spacebar with a lower, longer, louder thump

sounds.name: Mechanical Keypress
sounds.desc: A mechanical keyboard keypress: a bright click, a bottom-out thock and a faint release tick, different every time.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the bright click leaf, varied slightly per press

click.desc: Loudness of the click leaf and release tick: 0 a linear switch, 1 clicky

thock.desc: Loudness of the bottom-out thock: 0 light, 1 heavy

sounds.name: Radial Fan
sounds.desc: A quick fan of small pips round a ring for a radial menu or speed-dial opening, one per petal; closing folds back down.

open.desc: 1 fans out rising from left to right, 0 folds back falling from right to left

petals.desc: Number of petals, one pip each

pitch.desc: Note of the first petal; the others climb the pentatonic above it

gap.desc: Time between pips: short for a flutter, long for a stepped fan

sounds.name: Menu Slide
sounds.desc: An airy slide for a menu or drawer opening (rising, soft landing) and closing (falling, latch tick); size runs from dropdown to drawer.

open.desc: 1 plays the rising open with a soft landing, 0 the falling close with a latch tick

size.desc: Slide length, dropdown to drawer; on open also a lower, heavier landing

tone.desc: Register of the air sweep: 0 darker and lower, 1 brighter and higher

sounds.name: Modal Open and Close
sounds.desc: A soft low swell for a dialog opening, with a small glint on arrival, and a quick falling sigh for it closing.

open.desc: 1 plays the rising swell with a glint, 0 the quick falling sigh

pitch.desc: Tuning of the low swell or sigh tones; the glint stays fixed

air.desc: Loudness of the breath of air in the swell or sigh

shine.desc: Level of the high bell glint: 0 faint, 1 clear; it droops on close

sounds.name: Page Turn
sounds.desc: A paper page turned: a soft sweep of air, light rustles and a quiet landing. For pagers, carousels and readers.

length.desc: Duration of the turn: sweep, rustles and landing all stretch with it

rustle.desc: Level of the scattered paper rustles: 0 none, 1 crisp

bright.desc: Register of the air sweep: 0 darker and lower, 1 brighter and higher

sounds.name: Palette Open
sounds.desc: A quick upward glide into a small glassy ring for a command palette or search overlay opening; closing slips back down.

open.desc: 1 plays the glide up into the ring, 0 the short glide down with no ring

pitch.desc: Note of the glassy ring the glide lands on

ring.desc: How long the landing rings: 0 a short pip, 1 a longer glassy ring

sounds.name: Keypad Key
sounds.desc: A soft two-tone press for a PIN pad or numeric keypad, different for each digit; the last digit can add a small rising confirm.

key.desc: Which digit is pressed: each plays its own pair of tones, like a phone keypad

done.desc: 1 adds a rising two-note confirm after the key, 0 the key alone

pitch.desc: Shifts every tone of the key and the confirm up or down

body.desc: Level of the low thock of the button under the tones: 0 bare tones, 1 a firm press

sounds.name: Pulse Beat
sounds.desc: One soft lub-dub heartbeat. Re-trigger every 0.8 s at 72 bpm (60 divided by the rate) for a live dot or pulsing badge.

bpm.desc: Pulse rate: sets the gap inside the lub-dub, and the re-trigger interval to use

pitch.desc: Pitch of the thump: low a deep chest beat, high a lighter tap

soft.desc: Muffling: 0 a clearer knock, 1 a muted pillow thud

sounds.name: Radio Select
sounds.desc: A soft rounded bloop for picking one option from a group: a sine that bends upward over a quiet low body.

pitch.desc: Start note of the bloop; its octave-down body follows

bloop.desc: How far the sound bends upward: 0 a gentle lift, 1 a big rising bloop

round.desc: Level of the octave-down body: 0 thinner and chirpier, 1 fuller and rounder

sounds.name: Star Rating
sounds.desc: A run of rising glassy pings, one per star, for rating something; five stars add a small glint on top.

stars.desc: How many stars are chosen, one rising ping each

pitch.desc: Note of the first star; the others climb the pentatonic above it

gap.desc: Time between pings: short for a flutter, long for a stepped climb

glint.desc: Level of the sparkle that crowns five stars; other counts ignore it

sounds.name: Record Toggle
sounds.desc: Two short blips and a longer beep when recording starts, and one long falling tone when it stops.

on.desc: 1 plays the blip, blip, beep of a start, 0 the long falling tone of a stop

pitch.desc: Note of the blips; the final beep sits a fifth above and the stop falls from it

length.desc: Length of the final beep on a start; a stop falls for twice as long

sounds.name: Scroll Detent
sounds.desc: A tiny dry wooden tick for one notch of a scroll wheel or picker; raise ticks for a quick flick through several.

ticks.desc: How many notches tick past: 1 a single notch, more for a quick flick

pitch.desc: Note of each tick's short ring, varied slightly per notch

gap.desc: Time between notches when ticks is above 1: short spins fast, long slower

sounds.name: Shake No
sounds.desc: A soft two-note "uh-uh" that swings left and right. For a field that shakes, a refused input or a polite no.

pitch.desc: The higher note of the "uh-uh"

drop.desc: How far the second note falls below the first

shakes.desc: How many shakes: 2 is a plain "uh-uh", 4 a firmer "uh-uh-uh-uh"

rough.desc: Rasp under the hum: 0 a clean hum, 1 a buzzy growl

sounds.name: Sheet Snap
sounds.desc: A weighty drawer or bottom sheet sliding in and snapping into place with a small rebound; closing drops away with a soft thud.

open.desc: 1 plays the slide, snap and rebound, 0 the quick drop with a soft thud

weight.desc: How heavy the sheet feels: 0 light and higher, 1 a long slide and a deep thump

rebound.desc: Size of the small bounce after the snap on open: 0 none, 1 a clear settle

sounds.name: Slider Detent
sounds.desc: A small pitched tick for a slider thumb crossing a notch; set pos from the thumb position and a drag climbs a scale.

pitch.desc: Tick note at the bottom of the track; pos lifts it up to an octave

pos.desc: Thumb position along the track: 0 base note, 1 an octave up

edge.desc: Level of the noise click on top: 0 a soft tonal tick, 1 a sharp edge

sounds.name: Spring Settle
sounds.desc: A quiet wobbling tone that overshoots, swings up and down and settles to rest. For springy, elastic and jelly motion.

pitch.desc: The note the spring comes to rest on

wobble.desc: Speed of the swing: low a lazy sway, high a fast shiver

depth.desc: How far the first swing goes: 0 a gentle sway, 1 a big rubbery overshoot

settle.desc: How long the spring takes to come to rest

sounds.name: Rubber Stamp
sounds.desc: A rubber stamp landing on paper: a firm thump, a flat slap and a wet splat of ink, then a soft peel as it lifts. For approved, paid or verified.

weight.desc: Size of the stamp: 0 a light office stamp, 1 a heavy desk stamp with a deeper, longer thump

ink.desc: How wet the ink is: 0 a dry press, 1 a squelchy splat and a longer peel

pitch.desc: Note of the thump before it sags

sounds.name: Step Advance
sounds.desc: One soft rounded note per step, each higher on a gentle scale, landing with a small knock. Reaching the last step adds a bell glint on top.

step.desc: The step just reached: each number is a note higher on the scale

steps.desc: How many steps the flow has: reaching or passing the last adds the glint

pitch.desc: Note of step 1; the later steps climb from it

sounds.name: Number Stepper
sounds.desc: A tiny pip for the plus and minus of a number stepper: it hops up when the value rises and down when it falls.

up.desc: 1 plays the rising tick for an increase, 0 the falling tick for a decrease

pitch.desc: Resting note of the pip: the rise climbs past it and the fall drops below it

pat.desc: Level of the soft button pat under the pip: 0 a bare pip, 1 a clear tap

sounds.name: Tab Switch
sounds.desc: A short airy slide with a tiny landing pip for a tab, pill or segment taking the selection; the pitch follows where it lands.

pos.desc: Where the selection lands along the bar: 0 the first tab and lowest, 1 the last and an octave up

prev.desc: Where it slid from: the slide rises when prev is below pos and falls when above

air.desc: Level of the airy slide against the landing pip: 0 mostly pip, 1 a clear swish

sounds.name: Tap
sounds.desc: A soft fingertip tap for touch screens and list rows: a muffled pat over a short mid thud, rounder than a click.

pitch.desc: Tuning of the short mid thud

pat.desc: Loudness of the muffled noise pat over the thud

soft.desc: Muffling of the pat: 0 brighter and clearer, 1 duller and softer

sounds.name: Task Done
sounds.desc: A pen tick, a quick strike-through swipe and a small ding for a task crossed off. A streak adds a trail of rising glints.

streak.desc: Tasks finished in a row: each adds one more rising glint after the ding

pitch.desc: Note of the ding; the glints climb from it

swipe.desc: Level of the strike-through swipe: 0 just the tick and ding, 1 a clear stroke

sounds.name: Toggle Switch
sounds.desc: A two-stage click-clack for switches: rising when turned on, falling when turned off.

on.desc: 1 plays the click pair rising, 0 plays it falling

pitch.desc: Note of the higher click; the other sits about a fourth below

gap.desc: Time between the two clicks; the low thock lands with the second

body.desc: Level of the low thock under the second click: 0 none, 1 solid

sounds.name: Tooltip Pop
sounds.desc: A tiny glassy bubble pop for a tooltip or popover appearing: a bright pip that bends up and settles.

pitch.desc: Start note of the pip before it bends up

rise.desc: How far the pip bends up: 0 steady, 1 nearly an octave

shimmer.desc: Starting FM glitter before it settles: 0 nearly pure, 1 bright and sparkly

sounds.name: Typewriter Return
sounds.desc: A typewriter carriage return: a ratcheting slide, a knock at the stop and a bright margin bell. For typed lines finishing and retro text effects.

slide.desc: How long the carriage takes to run back

pitch.desc: Pitch of the margin bell

ring.desc: How long the bell rings

bell.desc: Level of the bell, 0 leaves only the carriage

sounds.name: Undo
sounds.desc: A short rewind flutter that falls and settles with a soft tick, for undoing the last action.

pitch.desc: Start note of the falling flutter; the settle tick sits an octave below

speed.desc: Flutter rate of the rewind: low a slow wobble, high a fast whir

settle.desc: Level of the soft tick where it settles: 0 faint, 1 clear

sounds.name: Field Verdict
sounds.desc: Two quick pips stepping up for a valid field, two short buzzing pips stepping down for an invalid one. Light enough to play on every keystroke check.

pass.desc: 1 plays the two rising pips for valid, 0 the two buzzing falling pips for invalid

pitch.desc: Note of the first pip; the second sits a third above (valid) or below (invalid)

rough.desc: How buzzy the invalid pips are: 0 smooth, 1 a light rattle (valid ignores it)

sounds.name: Directional Wipe
sounds.desc: A quiet band of air that sweeps across from one side to the other and lands with a tiny tick. For wipes, curtains, shutters and irises uncovering content.

dir.desc: 1 sweeps from left to right, 0 from right to left

length.desc: How long the wipe takes to cross

width.desc: Edge softness: 0 a thin hissing line, 1 a broad curtain of air

tick.desc: Level of the little tick where the wipe lands, 0 none

sounds.name: Achievement Unlocked
sounds.desc: A quick rising run into a warm bell chord with a few glints. A small celebration for something earned.

pitch.desc: Root note: transposes the run, the bell chord and the glints together

gap.desc: Spacing of the three run notes; the bell chord lands after the third

space.desc: Reverb mix over the whole sound, from dry to roomy

sparkle.desc: Level of the high sine glints over the chord, 0 removes them

sounds.name: Gentle Alarm
sounds.desc: Soft rounded beeps in rising pairs that swell round by round. Wakes you without startling you.

pitch.desc: Note of the first beep in each pair; the second is a fifth higher

rounds.desc: How many rounds of rising beep pairs play

pace.desc: Time between the two beeps in a pair

swell.desc: How much quieter the early rounds are: 0 all equal, 1 a strong build

sounds.name: Badge Pop
sounds.desc: One tiny bubbly pop for a badge count going up, with a fainter echo pop behind it. Each count is a step higher on a gentle scale.

count.desc: Badge count: each number is a note higher on a gentle scale, so use 10 for anything bigger

pitch.desc: Note for a count of 1; the higher counts climb from it

bubble.desc: How far each pop bends up into its note: 0 a plain blip, 1 a wet bubbly bloop

sounds.name: Banner Drop
sounds.desc: A weighted slide and a soft thud for a banner dropping in, with a low bong for an alert or a rising pair for an all-clear. It lifts out with a light slide and a latch tick.

open.desc: 1 drops the banner in with a thud and its tone, 0 lifts it out with a light slide and a tick

tone.desc: What the drop ends on: a bare thud, a low bong or a rising resolve (dropping in only)

weight.desc: Heft of the banner: 0 a light card, 1 a heavy slab with a longer slide and a deeper thud

sounds.name: Calendar Event
sounds.desc: A tiny page-flip tick and two soft plucked notes rising a fourth. An event is starting; warm and organized, not urgent.

pitch.desc: Note of the first pluck; the second sits the interval above

interval.desc: How far the second pluck rises above the first

gap.desc: Time between the two plucks

bright.desc: Opening filter cutoff of each pluck: low soft and muted, high twangy

tick.desc: Level of the page-flip noise tick before the notes, 0 removes it

sounds.name: Critical Alarm
sounds.desc: Two or three hard buzzing stabs, each higher than the last, over a shuddering low rumble. Unmistakably urgent, and over in under a second.

pitch.desc: Note of the first stab; the later ones climb from it

stabs.desc: Number of stabs in the alarm

rough.desc: Depth of the fast flutter in each stab: 0 a hard steady tone, 1 a rattling shudder

sub.desc: Level of the low rumble under the stabs, 0 removes it

sounds.name: Attention Double Tap
sounds.desc: Two soft wooden knocks, each a touch lower and quieter. A gentle "excuse me" that is barely a sound.

pitch.desc: Body pitch of the first knock; each later knock is a bit lower

gap.desc: Time between knocks, with a slight natural wobble

wood.desc: Level of the woody click on each knock: 0 a pure thud, 1 crisp wood

taps.desc: Number of knocks, each lower and softer than the last

sounds.name: Download Complete
sounds.desc: A soft downward glide that settles with a gentle thump and a small ting. The file is in place.

pitch.desc: Landing note; the glide starts an octave above it, the ting a fifth up

fall.desc: Length of the downward glide, which also delays the landing

thump.desc: Level of the low thump on landing, 0 removes it

ring.desc: How long the landing note and the ting ring out

sounds.name: Error Buzz
sounds.desc: A low falling double buzz for a rejected action. Clear without being harsh.

pitch.desc: Note of the first buzz; each further pulse steps lower

rough.desc: Depth of the fast level trill: 0 a smooth tone, 1 a rattling buzz

tone.desc: Lowpass cutoff: low is dull and muffled, high is brighter and edgier

sounds.name: Incoming Call Ring
sounds.desc: A short bell-like phone ring: bursts of fast alternating notes with a pause between. Loops cleanly if you repeat it.

pitch.desc: Lower note of the trill; the upper note is a major third above

rate.desc: Speed of the note alternation: low a slow warble, high a fast trill

tone.desc: Lowpass cutoff: low is soft and muted, high rings brighter

sounds.name: Info Ping
sounds.desc: One soft bell tap for neutral news: nothing wrong and nothing won, just a heads-up. Made to be heard all day.

pitch.desc: Note of the bell tap

decay.desc: How long the bell rings out

bright.desc: Level of the octave and the glassy partial: 0 soft and pure, 1 brighter

sounds.name: Low Battery
sounds.desc: Three slow falling notes under a closing filter, the last one sagging. Power is running out.

pitch.desc: Note of the first step; each next step falls a whole tone

steps.desc: Number of falling notes; the last one always sags

gap.desc: Time between the falling notes

tone.desc: Starting lowpass cutoff, closing as the notes fall: low muffled, high clearer

sounds.name: Mention Ping
sounds.desc: A quick grace note into a glassy bell ting with a soft echo. Stands out from ordinary messages without shouting.

pitch.desc: Note of the bell ting; the grace note before it is a fifth below

glass.desc: Level of the inharmonic partial: 0 a round ting, 1 a glassy metallic edge

ring.desc: How long the bell ting rings out

echo.desc: Level of the soft echo trailing the ting, 0 dry

sounds.name: Message Received
sounds.desc: Two quick bubbly pops rising a fourth, like a chat bubble arriving. Friendly and short enough for a busy channel.

pitch.desc: Note of the first pop; the second sits the interval above

interval.desc: How far the second pop rises above the first

gap.desc: Time between the two pops

pop.desc: Depth of the upward slide into each note: 0 a plain sine, 1 a bubbly bloop

sounds.name: Message Sent
sounds.desc: A soft rising whoosh into a tiny blip: your message is on its way. Quiet enough to play on every send.

pitch.desc: Note of the closing blip

speed.desc: Length of the whoosh before the blip: low quick, high slower

air.desc: Loudness of the rising air whoosh, from faint to breathy

sounds.name: New Mail
sounds.desc: A soft falling swish into a short-long two-bell "tu-ding". A letter has landed in the inbox.

pitch.desc: Note of the short first bell; the long second bell is the interval above

interval.desc: How far the second bell rises above the first

swish.desc: Loudness of the falling air swish before the bells

ring.desc: How long the second, longer bell rings out

sounds.name: Presence Change
sounds.desc: Two soft bell notes rising for someone coming online, one lower note sagging away for going offline. Gentle enough for a long contact list.

on.desc: 1 plays the rising online pair, 0 the single falling offline note

pitch.desc: Note of the offline tone and the first online note; the second online note sits a fourth above

glow.desc: Level of the octave shimmer and the soft echo: 0 plain and dry, 1 warm and glowing

sounds.name: Reminder Chime
sounds.desc: A soft two-bell "ding-dong" with a little room around it. A polite nudge that something is due.

pitch.desc: Note of the first bell, the ding

drop.desc: How far the second bell, the dong, falls below the first

gap.desc: Time between the ding and the dong

ring.desc: How long each bell rings out

space.desc: Reverb mix around the bells, from dry to a small roomy wash

sounds.name: Success Chime
sounds.desc: A gentle two-note rising chime for a completed action. Not a fanfare; a quiet yes.

pitch.desc: Note of the first chime; the second sits the interval above

interval.desc: How far the second note rises above the first

gap.desc: Time between the two notes

shimmer.desc: Level of the octave sine over the second note: 0 plain, 1 bright

sounds.name: Sync Done
sounds.desc: A quick back-and-forth of two notes that settles on the octave. Everything is in step again.

pitch.desc: Root of the back-and-forth; it swaps with the fifth and lands an octave up

cycles.desc: Number of root-fifth back-and-forth pairs before the landing note

speed.desc: Time per quick note: low a fast flutter, high a slower swap

shimmer.desc: Level of the high sine on the landing note, 0 removes it

sounds.name: Task Failed
sounds.desc: A run of low falling buzzes that sags on the last one. Something you were waiting on did not work out; firm, not harsh.

pitch.desc: Note of the first buzz and the sine under it; later pulses step lower

pulses.desc: Number of falling buzz pulses; the last one sags

rough.desc: Depth of the fast level trill: 0 a smooth tone, 1 a rattling buzz

weight.desc: Level of the low falling sine under the first pulse, 0 removes it

sounds.name: Toast Arrive
sounds.desc: A quick side swish that lands on a small tick and a short tone for the severity: a soft ping, a rising pair, a falling pair, a low buzz or three urgent stabs.

tone.desc: Severity of the toast: each has its own notes and voice

pitch.desc: Moves the landing notes down or up together

swish.desc: Level of the side swish before the landing: 0 just the tick, 1 a clear sweep

sounds.name: Toast Dismiss
sounds.desc: A quick falling swipe and a soft pat for a toast sliding away. With the drain on, a few small ticks run out first, for toasts that dismiss themselves.

speed.desc: How fast it goes: 1 a relaxed swipe, higher a flick

drain.desc: 1 adds three falling countdown ticks before the swipe, 0 just swipes away

pat.desc: Level of the soft pat at the end: 0 a clean swipe, 1 a clear settle

sounds.name: Upload Complete
sounds.desc: A soft upward glide that lands on a bright chime note. The file has arrived.

pitch.desc: Base pitch: the glide rises from below it to a landing note a fifth up

rise.desc: Length of the upward glide, which also delays the landing note

ring.desc: How long the landing note and its shimmer ring out

shimmer.desc: Level of the octave sine over the landing note, 0 removes it

sounds.name: Warning Tone
sounds.desc: A two-note falling "uh-oh" in a round triangle tone. Cautions without scolding; milder than the error buzz.

pitch.desc: Note of the first, short note of the uh-oh

drop.desc: How far the second note falls below the first

gap.desc: Time between the two notes

tone.desc: Lowpass cutoff: low is round and muted, high is brighter

sounds.name: Bar Rise
sounds.desc: A staggered run of soft marimba ticks, one per bar, each as high in pitch as the bar is tall. For bar charts drawing in.

bars.desc: How many bars tick, one after another

pitch.desc: Note of the shortest bar; taller bars climb the scale above it

gap.desc: Time between bars: short a quick flutter, long a stepped climb

climb.desc: Bar heights: 0 uneven and random, 1 a clean staircase up

sounds.name: Count-Up Roll
sounds.desc: A run of small ticks that speeds up, brakes and lands on a soft thunk, climbing in pitch: for a big number counting up to its value.

ticks.desc: Ticks before the landing: few a short count, many a fast roll

length.desc: Time from the first tick to the landing thunk

pitch.desc: Note of the first tick

rise.desc: How far the ticks climb by the last one: 0 a flat roll

thunk.desc: Weight of the landing: 0 almost none, 1 a clear soft thump

sounds.name: Counter Tick
sounds.desc: A tiny tick for one step of a number: set value from the count and a run of steps climbs in pitch. Glassy at one end, a dry wheel click at the other.

value.desc: Where the count sits: 0 the lowest tick, 1 an octave up

pitch.desc: Tick note at value 0

click.desc: Voicing: 0 a glassy tink, 1 a dry mechanical wheel click

sounds.name: Delta Tick
sounds.desc: A tiny two-note chirp for a number that changed: rising when it went up, falling when it went down.

up.desc: 1 plays a rising chirp (the value went up), 0 a falling, slightly quieter one

pitch.desc: Note of the lower chirp

size.desc: How big the change is: 0 a small step between the notes, 1 a wide leap

sounds.name: Failover
sounds.desc: A dull falling thud as a node goes down, a short silence, then a rising run of three notes as the backup takes over. For high availability and recovery diagrams.

pitch.desc: Pitch the node goes down from; the takeover run is built on it

gap.desc: Silence between the failure and the takeover: low a quick switch, high a long outage

bright.desc: How glassy the takeover is: 0 soft sines, 1 a bright bell on the last note

sounds.name: Fan-out
sounds.desc: One blip arrives and splits into a fan of blips that fly out across the stereo field, left to right, each a step higher. For a load balancer or a broadcast.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the blip that arrives; the branches climb from a third above it

branches.desc: How many blips it splits into

spread.desc: How wide the fan opens: 0 all branches in the centre, 1 hard left to hard right

stagger.desc: Time between branches: low a tight burst, high a slow arpeggio

sounds.name: Gauge Needle
sounds.desc: A small servo whir as a gauge needle swings to a new reading, a few springy bounces, then a soft detent tick as it settles.

sweep.desc: How far the needle travels: positive up the dial, negative back down, small a short hop

swing.desc: Spring overshoot when it arrives: 0 stops dead, 1 bounces a few times

pitch.desc: Pitch of the servo whir at the start of the move

sounds.name: Heat Bloom
sounds.desc: A soft cluster of tiny grains that swells and fades like a heat map filling in. Higher warmth is brighter and hotter.

warmth.desc: Pitch of the cluster: low a cool deep bloom, high a hot bright one

cells.desc: How many grains make up the cluster, sparse to dense

bloom.desc: How long the cluster takes to swell before it fades

spread.desc: Pitch scatter of the grains: 0 one note, 1 across an octave and a half

sounds.name: Line Draw
sounds.desc: A soft tone glides along a line as it is drawn, rising or falling with its trend, and glitters where the line arrives.

pitch.desc: Where the line starts, as a pitch

curve.desc: Where the line goes: -1 falls an octave, 0 stays level, 1 climbs an octave

wobble.desc: Ups and downs along the way: 0 a smooth glide, 1 a jagged line

length.desc: Time the line takes to draw

shimmer.desc: Glitter where the line arrives: 0 none, 1 a clear bright sparkle

sounds.name: Link Up / Down
sounds.desc: Link up is two quick blips and a soft settling note, a handshake that worked. Link down plays the blips falling and then sinks away.

on.desc: 1 a connection coming up, 0 a connection dropping

pitch.desc: Pitch of the first blip, the rest are built on it

speed.desc: Time between the two blips: low a quick handshake, high a deliberate one

tone.desc: Color of the blips: 0 round and muted, 1 glassier with a bright overtone

sounds.name: Liquid Fill
sounds.desc: Water glugging into a vessel with a pitch that climbs as the level rises. For tanks, batteries, thermometers and filling gauges.

pitch.desc: Pitch when the vessel is empty, rising from here as it fills

fill.desc: How full it gets: low a short rise, high a climb of two octaves to the brim

length.desc: Time the vessel takes to fill

glug.desc: How many glugs bubble up on the way

sounds.name: Wait Resolved
sounds.desc: A quick filled sweep that lands with a soft settle and a small check tick, for a spinner or skeleton that has finished. Quieter than a success chime.

pitch.desc: Note the sweep lands on, with the check ping an octave above

sweep.desc: Length of the rising sweep before it lands

check.desc: The landing: 0 a skeleton settling softly, 1 a bright check tick

sounds.name: Load Pulse
sounds.desc: A soft slow breath of sound for a loader that keeps waiting. One breath per play: re-trigger every 0.9 s (or at the breath length you set).

breath.desc: Length of one breath, which is also the time to re-trigger it

pitch.desc: Note of the breath, with a soft fifth above it

tone.desc: Warmth: 0 a plain hum, 1 a fuller breath with an octave and a little air

wobble.desc: Slow pitch waver through the breath: 0 steady, 1 a gentle sway

sounds.name: Log Tail
sounds.desc: A short burst of tiny typed blips, one run per log line, higher and edgier from debug to error. Re-trigger every 1.5 s while a log streams.

level.desc: Log level: pitch climbs from debug to error, and warn and error get an edge

lines.desc: How many log lines scroll by in the burst

pace.desc: Time between lines: short a fast scroll, long a sparse one

sounds.name: Monitor Beep
sounds.desc: One clean beep of a patient monitor, with an optional soft heartbeat under it. Re-trigger every 0.8 s for 75 beats per minute.

pitch.desc: Note of the beep: low a calm monitor, high a sharp one

length.desc: How long the beep holds before it stops

soft.desc: Edges of the beep: 0 sharp and clean, 1 rounded and mellow

thump.desc: Level of the low lub-dub heartbeat under the beep: 0 none, 1 clear

sounds.name: Nixie Strike
sounds.desc: A glassy snap and a fizz of sparks as a nixie tube lights, then a warm electrical hum that swells and fades: for a retro digit appearing.

snap.desc: The strike: 0 a muffled tick, 1 a bright glassy snap with more sparks

hum.desc: Level of the warm hum after the strike: 0 almost none, 1 a full glow

pitch.desc: Pitch of the hum: low a deep warm drone, high a thinner whine

glow.desc: How long the hum lingers before it fades

sounds.name: Packet Hop
sounds.desc: A tiny blip hops from node to node, climbing a scale step per hop as it crosses the stereo field, and lands with a soft tick. Quiet enough to fire every few hundred milliseconds.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the first hop; every later hop climbs one step of a scale

hops.desc: How many hops before the packet lands

travel.desc: How far it crosses the stereo field: positive left to right, negative right to left, 0 stays centred

tone.desc: Color of each blip: 0 a round, muted sine, 1 a glassier one with a bright overtone

sounds.name: Pin Drop
sounds.desc: A map pin drops onto its spot with a quick falling swish, a soft landing tap, a glassy tink and a small bounce. For a marker appearing on a map.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the glassy tink: low a bigger pin, high a tiny one

height.desc: How long the pin falls before it lands: low a short hop, high a long drop

bounce.desc: Size of the small bounce after landing: 0 lands dead, 1 hops back clearly

glint.desc: How glassy the landing is: 0 a dull tap on cork, 1 a bright ring

sounds.name: Progress Fill
sounds.desc: A short rising glide whose note follows the progress: call it on every update with pos from 0 to 1 and the updates draw one climbing line.

pos.desc: How full the bar is: 0 the lowest note, 1 the highest

pitch.desc: Note at an empty bar

span.desc: How far the pitch climbs from empty to full

ticks.desc: Stair steps along the bar with a soft tick on each: 0 a smooth glide

sounds.name: Request / Response
sounds.desc: A short rising blip goes out, a pause for the latency, and a soft two-note chime comes back. For an API call, a DNS lookup or any request with a reply.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the outgoing request; the reply chime is built on it

latency.desc: Silence between the request and the reply: low a fast cache hit, high a slow server

width.desc: How far the request flies out to the right and the reply back to the left: 0 stays centred

sounds.name: Route Trace
sounds.desc: A soft rising glide with a small glass tick at each waypoint and a bell where the trip ends. For a dot or vehicle travelling a route on a map.

pitch.desc: Where the glide starts; it climbs an octave to the arrival bell

length.desc: How long the trip takes before the arrival bell

waypoints.desc: How many stops it passes on the way, 0 for a straight run

width.desc: How far the dot drifts across the stereo field: 0 stays centred, 1 sweeps left to right

sounds.name: Scale Out / In
sounds.desc: Scaling out piles up a run of rising blips into a chord, scaling in drops a run of short blips down and away. For auto scaling, capacity and fleet size changes.

up.desc: 1 scaling out with blips that rise and stack up, 0 scaling in with blips that fall away

count.desc: How many instances are added or removed, one blip each

pitch.desc: Pitch of the lowest blip of the run

speed.desc: Time between blips: low a quick burst, high a slow build

sounds.name: Sonar Ping
sounds.desc: One clean sonar ping that fades into a few softer, darker echoes. For a you-are-here marker, an accuracy ring or an outage ripple spreading from a point.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the ping: low deep and distant, high small and close

echoes.desc: How many echoes come back after the ping, 0 for the bare ping

gap.desc: Time between the ping and each echo: low a close wall, high a far one

bright.desc: Overtones in the ping: 0 a pure sine, 1 a harder, glassier ping

sounds.name: Sort Swap
sounds.desc: Rows trading places: crossing glides, a pair of landing ticks and a quiet slide. Raise swaps for a longer sort.

swaps.desc: How many swaps in the run, one after another

pitch.desc: Note of the lower row as it moves

gap.desc: Time between swaps

slide.desc: Level of the slide between the ticks: 0 only ticks, 1 a clear whoosh

sounds.name: Spinner Ticks
sounds.desc: A soft ring of ticks that turns once per play, circling from side to side. Re-trigger every 1.0 s (or at the turn time you set) for a steady spinner.

steps.desc: Ticks in one turn: few a slow clock, many a fine ratchet

turn.desc: Time for one full turn, which is also the time to re-trigger it

pitch.desc: Lowest tick, at the bottom of the ring; the top is a fourth higher

tone.desc: Edge of each tick: 0 a round bloop, 1 a drier wooden tick

width.desc: How far the sound travels left and right round the ring: 0 centred

sounds.name: Flap Clack
sounds.desc: A rolling clatter of hinged cards falling, character by character, each landing on a firmer clack: for a split-flap board or flip clock changing.

digits.desc: Characters changing, starting one after another across the board

cards.desc: Cards each character flips through before it lands

speed.desc: Time between cards: short a fast rattle, long a lazy fall

tone.desc: Material: 0 soft cardboard flicks, 1 hard plastic clacks

sounds.name: Threshold Cross
sounds.desc: Two pips as a meter crosses a line: a soft rising pair for green, a repeated note for amber, a rough falling pair for red.

level.desc: How serious the crossing is: 0 green and gentle, 0.5 amber, 1 red, rough and heavier

rising.desc: 1 the meter climbs across the line, 0 it falls back across, playing the pair reversed and softer

pitch.desc: Note of the first pip

sounds.name: Denoise
sounds.desc: A haze of static that narrows and sweeps down until it settles into one clean tone. An image or an answer coming into focus.

pitch.desc: Note the static settles on

length.desc: Time the static takes to clear before the tone rings

grain.desc: How the static starts: 0 a soft low haze, 1 bright, hissy grit

sounds.name: Guardrail Verdict
sounds.desc: A check on what an AI is about to do: a small clear ding when it is allowed, a dull thud with a short low buzz when it is blocked.

pass.desc: Verdict: 1 allowed with a clear ding, 0 blocked with a thud and buzz

pitch.desc: Pitch of the ding; the blocked thud and buzz sit well below it

edge.desc: How firm it is: a brighter ding when allowed, a rougher buzz when blocked

sounds.name: Agent Handoff
sounds.desc: A single note slides from one side to the other and changes voice on the way, from a warm tone to a glassy ring. One agent handing the work to the next.

pitch.desc: Note the first agent starts on; it climbs a fifth as it travels

travel.desc: Time the note takes to cross: a quick toss or a slow carry

change.desc: How different the second voice is: 0 a soft tone, 1 a bright glassy ring

sounds.name: Reasoning Step
sounds.desc: A soft glassy note that slides up from the last one and echoes twice. Each step climbs one note of a gentle scale, so a chain of thought rises as it goes.

step.desc: Which step of the chain: each one climbs a note of the scale

pitch.desc: Note of the first step; the later steps climb up to two octaves above it

glow.desc: Level of the two echoes: 0 a single clean note, 1 a lingering thought

sounds.name: Retrieval Sweep
sounds.desc: A quick run of rising glassy glints, faster as they climb, that settles on one clear ping. A knowledge lookup finding its match.

glints.desc: How many candidates flash by before the match

pitch.desc: Note of the final ping; the glints climb to it from over an octave below

sweep.desc: Time the glints take to climb before the ping

sounds.name: Stream Done
sounds.desc: A small tock as the cursor stops, then a soft two-note glass chime falling to rest. For the end of a streamed reply or a finished generation.

pitch.desc: Note of the first chime; the second falls below it

fall.desc: How far the second note falls: a small sigh to a settled drop

glow.desc: Air around the chime: 0 dry and close, 1 a soft shimmering room

cursor.desc: Level of the small tock as the cursor stops: 0 none, 1 clear

sounds.name: Thinking Hum
sounds.desc: A warm, quiet breath of sound for an assistant that is working: one soft swell that fades to silence. Re-trigger every 1.4 s for as long as it thinks.

pitch.desc: Note of the hum, from a low murmur to a lighter voice

depth.desc: How deeply it breathes: 0 a quick, steady pad, 1 a long swell that opens up

tone.desc: Warmth: 0 dark and rounded, 1 a brighter glassy edge

sounds.name: Token Stream
sounds.desc: A fast patter of tiny glassy pips on an uneven beat, like a reply streaming in word by word. Machine text, not a keyboard.

tokens.desc: How many pips arrive in the burst

rate.desc: Tokens per second: a slow, readable stream up to a rapid flood

pitch.desc: Lowest pip of the scale; the rest climb up to two octaves above it

spread.desc: How far the pips wander in pitch: 0 all one note, 1 across the whole scale

sounds.name: Tool Call
sounds.desc: A small blip as a request goes out, a short wait, then the answer: a clear glass ding when the call works, a soft low drop when it fails.

ok.desc: Result of the call: 1 a clear ding, 0 a soft low drop for a failure

latency.desc: How long the call takes before the answer lands

pitch.desc: Note of the answer; the request blip and the failure drop sit around it

sounds.name: Typing Dots
sounds.desc: Three soft rising bloops in a row, like the dots of a typing indicator. Re-trigger every 1.2 s while the other side is writing.

pitch.desc: Note of the first dot; the next two sit a whole step higher each

gap.desc: Time between the dots: short a quick bounce, long a lazy one

glass.desc: Glassy octave over each dot: 0 a plain round bloop, 1 a bright bubble

sounds.name: Arrow Shot
sounds.desc: A bowstring twang and the zip of an arrow leaving. For archers and ranged attacks.

pitch.desc: Note of the plucked bowstring and the short thump under it

flight.desc: How long the arrow's falling noise zip lasts as it recedes

twang.desc: String brightness and sustain: 0 a dull short pluck, 1 a bright ringing twang

sounds.name: Bounce
sounds.desc: A rubbery boing: a quick spring up, then a wobble that settles. For jump pads, springs and balls.

pitch.desc: Note the boing settles on after springing up to nearly an octave above

wobble.desc: Vibrato on the settle: 0 a clean glide, 1 a wide rubbery wobble

length.desc: How long the boing takes to settle back down and fade

sounds.name: Checkpoint
sounds.desc: A soft thump and three bells fanning up that ring together: progress saved. Warmer than a success chime.

pitch.desc: Root note of the three-bell chord of root, fifth and octave

spread.desc: Gap between the three bell strikes, from near-chord to a slow fan

ring.desc: How long each bell rings out

sounds.name: Coin Flip
sounds.desc: A coin spun into the air: rising ticks as it turns, then a bright ping when it lands.

spins.desc: How many rising ticks play while the coin turns before it lands

spin.desc: Time between spin ticks; longer also delays the landing ping

pitch.desc: Note of the landing ping; the spin ticks follow it, lower down

ring.desc: How long the landing ping rings out

sounds.name: Combo Ping
sounds.desc: A short bright ping that rises one scale step per streak count, so a combo plays a rising tune. Chip makes it a square ping.

pitch.desc: Base note at a streak of 1; higher streaks climb a pentatonic scale from it

streak.desc: Combo count: each step plays the next note up a pentatonic scale

ring.desc: How long the ping rings out

chip.desc: 1 a bitcrushed square ping, 0 a soft near-harmonic bell

sounds.name: Countdown Beep
sounds.desc: The beep for 3, 2, 1 in a race or round start; turn Go on for the longer, higher start tone.

pitch.desc: Note of the beep; Go plays an octave above it

length.desc: How long the beep holds; Go stretches it further

go.desc: 1 the start tone: octave up, longer, with a fifth, 0 a plain count beep

chip.desc: 1 a bitcrushed square beep, 0 a clean sine with a soft octave

sounds.name: Door Open
sounds.desc: A latch clicks and a wooden hinge creaks open. Use a short length for a quick door, long for a spooky one.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the hinge creak, which climbs as the door swings

length.desc: How long the hinge creaks as the door swings open

creak.desc: Roughness of the hinge: 0 a smoother groan, 1 a juddering, wobbly creak with grit

sounds.name: Double Jump
sounds.desc: Two hops in a row, the second higher and quicker, for a mid-air jump. Chip is square; off is soft triangle.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the first hop's sweep; the second hop scales with it

gap.desc: Time between the first hop and the second

lift.desc: How much higher the second hop starts than the first

chip.desc: 1 a bitcrushed square voice, 0 a soft triangle with a sine sheen and air puff

sounds.name: Explosion Soft
sounds.desc: A big but friendly boom: a round blast with a pop on the front and crackles after. Cartoon, not harsh.

size.desc: How long the boom's noise body and falling sub last

pitch.desc: Base note of the falling sub under the blast; lower is deeper

soften.desc: Darkens the blast: 0 a brighter bang, 1 a muffled puff

crackle.desc: Loudness of the tiny crackles scattered after the boom, 0 none

sounds.name: Footstep Hard
sounds.desc: A step on wood, tile or stone: a crisp tap with a knock under it. Use Vary for a walking rhythm.

surface.desc: Floor material: 0 wood with a dull, lower knock, 1 stone with a bright click and ring

weight.desc: How heavy the step is: a louder knock and a stronger low thud under it

pitch.desc: Scales the tuning of the whole step: click, knock, thud and ring

sounds.name: Footstep Soft
sounds.desc: A quiet step on carpet, grass or sand. Use Vary so a walk never repeats exactly.

weight.desc: How heavy the step is: a louder puff and a fuller low thud

surface.desc: Ground type: 0 muffled carpet, 1 brighter gravel with a little crunch

length.desc: How long each step's puff and thud last

sounds.name: Gem Collect
sounds.desc: A crystalline two-strike ring for a gem or treasure: bright, glassy and a little longer than a coin.

pitch.desc: Note of the first glass strike; the second rings a fifth above

ring.desc: How long the glass strikes ring, the second a bit longer

gap.desc: Time between the two glass strikes

sparkle.desc: Level of the airy shimmer on the second strike, 0 none

sounds.name: Hammer Hit
sounds.desc: A hammer swung and landing on metal: air, then a clank with a thump under it.

swing.desc: Length of the rising air before impact; near zero it hits at once

pitch.desc: Note of the metal clank and its falling ring

weight.desc: Low body thump at contact: 0 a thin clank, 1 a heavy hit

ring.desc: How long the metal clank rings out

sounds.name: Heal
sounds.desc: A warm rising swell with a soft glow on top, for health restored. Gentle by design; it can repeat.

pitch.desc: Starting root of the rising root, fifth and octave chord

length.desc: How long the swell lasts; its slow bloom and rise stretch with it

rise.desc: How far the chord glides up during the swell; 0 holds steady

glow.desc: Level of the airy glow and the bell at the crest: 0 a plain swell

sounds.name: Hit Heavy
sounds.desc: A heavy blow landing: deep sub, a body of rumble and a hard crack. For bosses, crits and slams.

weight.desc: Heft of the blow: a louder sub and rumble body

pitch.desc: Base note of the falling sub; lower is deeper

crack.desc: Level of the hard high crack at the moment of impact

tail.desc: How long the rumble body and sub carry on after the hit

sounds.name: Hit Light
sounds.desc: A quick, light strike landing: a short knock with a crisp crack. Small enough to chain in a fight.

pitch.desc: Note of the short falling knock

snap.desc: Crack brightness and level: 0 a dull tap, 1 a crisp bright snap

body.desc: Level of the knock under the crack: 0 thin, 1 fat

sounds.name: Hurt
sounds.desc: A falling, wobbling "ow" with a crunch on the hit, for the player taking damage. Chip is square; off is a softer saw.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the falling ow

drop.desc: How far the ow falls in pitch: low a slight sag, high a deep plunge

length.desc: How long the ow lasts; the falling glide stretches with it

chip.desc: 1 a bitcrushed square ow, 0 a softer sawtooth through a closing lowpass

sounds.name: Jump
sounds.desc: The classic platformer hop: a quick rising sweep. Chip is a stepped square wave; off is a soft triangle.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the upward sweep

rise.desc: How far the sweep climbs above the start note

length.desc: How long the hop lasts and how slowly it sweeps

chip.desc: 1 a stepped, bitcrushed square sweep, 0 a soft triangle with a sine octave

sounds.name: Key Unlock
sounds.desc: A key jingles, turns and the lock gives: tiny metal ticks, a bolt clunk and a small ding.

pitch.desc: Note of the metal jingles; the final ding sits an octave below

jingles.desc: How many tiny key jingles rattle before the turn

clunk.desc: Weight of the deadbolt: a louder low thud and knock

ding.desc: Level of the small reward ding after the bolt, 0 none

sounds.name: Land
sounds.desc: A character landing after a jump or fall: a soft thump with a scuff of grit. Heavier settings hit longer.

weight.desc: Heft of the landing: a louder, longer thump and impact puff

pitch.desc: Note of the falling thump; lower is deeper

scuff.desc: Grit on landing: a louder, longer scuff and a brighter puff

sounds.name: Pickup Item
sounds.desc: A soft two-note blip for picking up an item. Quiet enough to repeat. Chip switches to square notes.

pitch.desc: Note of the first blip

interval.desc: How far above the first blip the second one lands

gap.desc: Time between the two blips

chip.desc: 1 two bitcrushed square notes, 0 soft sines with a sparkle and a speck of air

sounds.name: Power Up
sounds.desc: A quick rising scale that lands on a held note: you got stronger. Chip is square; off is soft triangle.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the rising scale run

notes.desc: How many notes the run plays, the last one held

gap.desc: Time between notes in the run; smaller is faster

chip.desc: 1 bitcrushed square notes, 0 soft triangles with an octave and vibrato at the end

sounds.name: Punch
sounds.desc: A fist landing with a thump and a smack. Up to three in a flurry, each slightly softer.

pitch.desc: Note of the falling thump; lower is meatier

snap.desc: Brighter smack and louder high slap: 0 a dull thud, 1 a crisp snap

hits.desc: How many punches land in the flurry, each a little softer

gap.desc: Time between punches in a flurry

sounds.name: Shield Up
sounds.desc: An energy field charging up: a humming rise that opens and locks in with a ping. For shields and buffs.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the hum, which climbs an octave; the lock ping follows it

length.desc: How long the shield takes to charge; the lock ping lands near the end

shimmer.desc: Level of the airy shimmer rising with the hum, 0 none

lock.desc: Level of the glassy ping when it locks in, 0 none

sounds.name: Sword Clash
sounds.desc: Steel meeting steel: a hard clang that rings, with an optional scrape. For parries and duels.

pitch.desc: Note of the clang; the second blade rings a third above

ring.desc: How long the steel rings after the clash

scrape.desc: Level and length of the blade-on-blade scrape, 0 none

sounds.name: Sword Swing
sounds.desc: A blade cutting the air: a quick bright swish with a thin edge of steel. Sharper than the generic whoosh.

length.desc: How long the swish takes; attack and tail stretch together

pitch.desc: Shifts the swish bands and the steel ring up or down

edge.desc: Level of the thin steel ring under the swish: 0 pure air

sounds.name: Referee Whistle
sounds.desc: A referee's whistle blast with a trilling pea and a card snap before it, or, switched to fizzle, a whistle that sags and runs out of air.

fizzle.desc: 0 a sharp blast after a card snap, 1 a whistle that sags and deflates

pitch.desc: Pitch of the whistle: low a big referee, high a small shrill one

length.desc: How long the blast holds

pea.desc: How hard the pea trills: 0 a clean tone, 1 a rattling warble

sounds.name: Whoosh
sounds.desc: Air rushing past: a swing, a dash, or a panel sliding across the screen.

length.desc: How long the whoosh lasts; both sweeps stretch with it

pitch.desc: Shifts both sweep bands: low a deep rush, high a thin hiss

q.desc: Narrowness of the sweeps: low a broad rush, high a tighter, whistly band

sounds.name: Your Turn Jingle
sounds.desc: A bright arcade cue for the start of your turn: a swoop up into a quick arpeggio that lands on a held, shimmering octave.

pitch.desc: Root note; the arpeggio climbs to the octave above it

notes.desc: Notes in the arpeggio: 2 root and octave, 3 adds the fifth, 4 the third

gap.desc: Time between the arpeggio notes

hold.desc: How long the last, highest note holds

chip.desc: 1 a bitcrushed square, 0 a bright pulse with a soft octave

sounds.name: Ability Trigger
sounds.desc: A short rising glide with a bright two-note ping: a creature ability switching on. Power fills it out with a low swell.

pitch.desc: Start note of the rising glide, which climbs an octave

power.desc: How big the activation feels: 0 a light trigger, 1 a fuller rise with a low swell and a third ping

ring.desc: How long the banner pings ring

sounds.name: Drawn Arrow
sounds.desc: A bow drawn tight, an arrow whistling in and a thunk where it lands. No twang, dry, so it stacks under any element.

draw.desc: How long the bow is drawn: a creak of rising tension before the release

flight.desc: How long the arrow whistles in flight

whistle.desc: Note of the whistle as the arrow closes in

thunk.desc: Weight of the landing: 0 a light tick, 1 a heavy thud

quiver.desc: Level of the short shiver of the shaft after it lands, 0 none

sounds.name: Crossing Shear
sounds.desc: Two crossing cuts that snap shut like shears, with a low chop where they meet. Short and dry, so it stacks under any element.

gap.desc: Time between the two cuts; short is one slash, long is two

edge.desc: Steel in the cut: 0 a plain whip of air, 1 bright metallic snaps

weight.desc: Low body where the cuts cross: 0 a thin slice, 1 a solid chop

sounds.name: Claw Rake
sounds.desc: Up to five tearing swipes raked in a row, ending in a low thud. Dry and ragged, so it stacks under any element strike.

claws.desc: How many tearing swipes rake across

rake.desc: Time between swipes; short is one ripping rake, long is separate slashes

tear.desc: Roughness of the swipes: 0 clean whips of air, 1 a ragged ripping rasp

weight.desc: Low thud at the end of the rake: 0 a light tap, 1 a solid body

sounds.name: Spinning Crescents
sounds.desc: Up to three spinning blades whirring across in an arc, bursting into bright points at the end. Dry, so it stacks under any element.

flight.desc: How long the blades fly before they burst

spin.desc: How fast the blades whirr; low a slow throb, high a buzzing spin

discs.desc: How many blades are thrown, each a little higher than the last

stars.desc: Level and length of the bright points at the end, 0 none

sounds.name: Plunging Dive
sounds.desc: A fast plunging dive: a falling whistle, a dull landing and optional small airy taps after it. Dry, so it stacks under any element.

drop.desc: Length of the plunge before it lands; longer is a slower, higher dive

pitch.desc: Start note of the falling whistle

wisps.desc: How many small airy taps follow the landing, 0 none

sounds.name: Fist Jab
sounds.desc: A single driving jab: a rush of air, a dull thud and a deep shockwave rolling out. Dry, so it stacks under any element strike.

reach.desc: Length of the rush of air and hum before the fist lands

weight.desc: Heft of the blow: 0 a light tap, 1 a deep, slow thud

shock.desc: Level and length of the shockwave that rolls out after contact

sounds.name: Palm Slam
sounds.desc: A big flat hand coming down: a low swell, then a heavy landing with a deep sub and settling dust. No crack, no ring.

descent.desc: How long the palm takes to come down; longer is a slower, heavier approach

weight.desc: Depth and length of the sub boom: 0 a flat slap, 1 a deep, long press

dust.desc: Level and length of the soft noise settling after the slam

sounds.name: Rapid Volley
sounds.desc: A quick flurry of two to eight light blows ending on a heavier one. Dry and fast, for multi-hit attacks.

hits.desc: How many blows land in the flurry, the last one the finisher

gap.desc: Time between blows; small is a blur, large is a count

finish.desc: Weight of the last blow: 0 as light as the rest, 1 clearly heavier

pitch.desc: Note of the light thumps; lower is meatier

sounds.name: Coin Chain
sounds.desc: A row of coins settling one after another: each heads rings a little higher than the last, each tails lands with a dull clack. For a run of coin flips.

flips.desc: How many coins land in the row

heads.desc: How many coins land heads, first in the row (never more than the flips)

gap.desc: Time between one coin landing and the next

pitch.desc: Note of the first heads ring; each later heads climbs above it

sounds.name: Counters
sounds.desc: Damage counters on a card: the discs click down one by one when placed, or lift off in a climbing run of soft plucks.

up.desc: 1 lifts the counters off in a climbing run of plucks, 0 drops them on one by one with a disc click

gap.desc: Time between one counter and the next

pitch.desc: Note of the first pluck when lifting; the disc clicks sit higher or lower with it

sounds.name: Energy Attach
sounds.desc: An energy card clicked on to a creature with a short chime. Each element has its own note; a special energy adds a gold ring.

element.desc: Which element: each step is another note of a pentatonic scale, 0 lowest

special.desc: 1 adds the gold ring of a special energy: a higher octave note and a shimmer

ring.desc: How long the chime rings after the click

sounds.name: Energy Break
sounds.desc: An energy card smashed: a swing of air, a clank and crack, a shower of tiny shards and a dull thud. For discarding an opponent's energy.

swing.desc: Length of the windup swish before the hit: 0 none, longer is a bigger swing

shards.desc: How many tiny shards skitter away after the hit

weight.desc: The low stone thud under the break: 0 light and brittle, 1 heavy

sounds.name: Evolve
sounds.desc: A creature changing form: a chord swelling up an octave like a column of light and landing on a bright ping. Off, it falls away.

up.desc: 1 a rising column of light ending in a bright ping, 0 the same falling away to a soft low note

pitch.desc: Base note of the chord, which moves an octave

length.desc: How long the chord takes to rise or fall

shimmer.desc: Level of the airy sparkle that rises or falls with the chord, 0 none

sounds.name: Tether Hook
sounds.desc: A thrown line that hooks and reels something in: a fast zip out, a metal bite, a ratcheting pull and a soft landing. For dragging an opponent into play.

length.desc: Time from the throw to the landing; the bite comes 40% of the way in

clicks.desc: How many ratchet clicks the reel makes

pitch.desc: Note of the metal bite when the hook catches

sounds.name: Knockout
sounds.desc: A creature going down: a short crack, a falling body and a slow deep sub, then a dull settle. Heavier than a hit, not louder.

weight.desc: Heft of the fall: more deep sub and a harder settle, never louder

pitch.desc: Start note of the falling body; lower is bigger

length.desc: How long the deep sub sighs out after the body lands

crack.desc: Level of the short bright crack that starts it

sounds.name: Prize Taken
sounds.desc: A prize card lifted and turned over with a glint, then a bright two-note chime. For scoring a point by taking a prize.

count.desc: How many prize cards are taken at once

pitch.desc: First note of the chime; the second is a fifth above and the glint sits well over both

gap.desc: Time between prize cards when more than one is taken

sounds.name: Burned
sounds.desc: The burned condition: a flame catching with a few crackles when it lands, a quick sizzle at each turn checkup, and a hiss of steam when it goes out.

tick.desc: 0 plays the flame catching, 1 the short sizzle that ticks at each turn checkup

cure.desc: 1 plays the recovery instead (it wins over tick): steam hissing as the fire goes out

heat.desc: How fierce the fire sounds: 0 low and smoldering, 1 bright and sharp

crackle.desc: How many crackles the flame spits when it catches

sounds.name: Confused
sounds.desc: The confused condition: a dizzy wobbling tone with twinkling stars when it lands, a dull bonk with two stars at each turn check, and two clear notes when the head clears.

tick.desc: 0 plays the dizzy wobble and stars, 1 the bonk of hitting itself that ticks at each turn

cure.desc: 1 plays the recovery instead (it wins over tick): the wobble steadies into two clear notes

wobble.desc: Speed of the dizzy wobble: slow is a lazy sway, fast is a spin

stars.desc: How many stars twinkle over the wobble when the condition lands

sounds.name: Paralyzed
sounds.desc: The paralyzed condition: a stiff electric buzz with sharp zaps when it lands, a halting twitch at each turn checkup, and a loosening pop when it wears off.

tick.desc: 0 plays the buzz and zaps of being paralyzed, 1 the halting twitch at each turn checkup

cure.desc: 1 plays the recovery instead (it wins over tick): the buzz winds down into a springy pop

buzz.desc: Pitch of the buzz: low is a heavy stiff hum, high a thin electric whine

zaps.desc: How many sharp zaps ride on the buzz when the condition lands

sounds.name: Poisoned
sounds.desc: The poisoned condition: thick bubbles welling up when it lands, a pair of small pops at each turn checkup, and a clear rising run when it is cured.

tick.desc: 0 plays the sound of becoming poisoned, 1 the two small pops that tick at each turn checkup

cure.desc: 1 plays the recovery instead (it wins over tick): the bubbles speed upward into two clean notes

pitch.desc: Where the bubbles start: low is thick sludge, high is thin and quick

bubbles.desc: How many bubbles well up when the poison lands

sounds.name: Asleep
sounds.desc: The asleep condition: a falling lullaby when it lands, a slow snore at each turn checkup, and a sudden bright pop when the sleeper wakes.

tick.desc: 0 plays the lullaby of falling asleep, 1 the snore that ticks at each turn checkup

cure.desc: 1 plays the waking instead (it wins over tick): a rising pop into two bright notes

pitch.desc: The first note of the lullaby; the second falls a fourth below it

breath.desc: How much soft breathing runs under the lullaby and the snore: 0 none, 1 airy

sounds.name: Colorless Strike
sounds.desc: A plain strike: a clean rush of air swells in, then lands as a light, dry thump with a short pop and no tail. For a neutral attack.

travel.desc: How long the rush lasts before the hit lands: short a snap, long a slow approach

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light, high thump up to a lower, longer one

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Darkness Strike
sounds.desc: A darkness strike: a shadow smears downward with a faint wail, then lands as a deep, dull thud that throbs and fades. For a dark attack.

travel.desc: How long the shadow sinks before it lands: short a snap, long a slow dread

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light smear up to a deeper, longer, heavier one

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Dragon Strike
sounds.desc: A dragon strike: a growling rush rises with a low tone wavering, then lands as a rough falling roar and a breath of air. For a dragon attack.

travel.desc: How long the growl rises before it lands: short a snap, long a slow approach

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light, high roar up to a deeper, longer one

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Fairy Strike
sounds.desc: A fairy strike: a bright rush climbs with a shimmering pair of tones and glints, then lands as a soft chime and a twinkle. For a fairy attack.

travel.desc: How long the shimmer climbs before it lands: short a snap, long a slow approach

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light, high chime up to a lower, fuller one

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Fighting Strike
sounds.desc: A fighting strike: air rushes in with a low tone rising, then lands as a deep thud with a slap and a puff of dust. For a punch or kick attack.

travel.desc: How long the rush lasts before the blow lands: short a snap, long a slow wind-up

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light thud up to a deeper, longer, dustier blow

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Fire Strike
sounds.desc: A fire strike: a flare rushes in with embers spitting, then lands as a low whoomph and a roar that crackles out. For a fire attack.

travel.desc: How long the flare flies before it lands: short a snap, long a slow approach

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light burst up to a deeper, longer blow

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Grass Strike
sounds.desc: A grass strike: leaves rush in with a resonant rustle and a thin whistle, then land as a thwack and a scatter of leaves. For a plant attack.

travel.desc: How long the leaves rush before they land: short a snap, long a slow approach

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light brush up to a heavier thwack and longer scatter

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Lightning Strike
sounds.desc: A lightning bolt: a charge builds with a fizzing hum and sparks, then lands as a bright crack, a sizzle and a low rumble. For an electric attack.

travel.desc: How long the charge builds before the bolt lands: short a snap, long a slow build

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a thin snap up to a deeper crack and longer sizzle

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Metal Strike
sounds.desc: A metal strike: a bright rush with a thin singing tone, then lands as a steel clang with a hard tick and a short ring. For a steel attack.

travel.desc: How long the blade sings before it lands: short a snap, long a slow approach

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light, high tink up to a lower, heavier clang

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Prism Strike
sounds.desc: A strike of three elements at once: fire, water and lightning rush in under one swell, then land crack, whoomph and splash with a glint. For a multi-element attack.

travel.desc: How long the layered swell flies before it lands: short a snap, long a slow approach

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light burst up to deeper, longer layers

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Psychic Strike
sounds.desc: A psychic strike: two wavering tones rise and beat against each other, then land as a falling pulse with a soft ping. For a mind attack.
