travel.desc: How long the tones rise before they land: short a snap, long a slow approach

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light, high pulse up to a lower, longer one

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Water Strike
sounds.desc: A water strike: a wave rushes in with bubbles popping, then splashes down with a thump, spray and falling droplets. For a water attack.

travel.desc: How long the wave rushes before it lands: short a snap, long a slow approach

power.desc: How hard it lands: from a light splash up to a deeper, longer burst

weak.desc: 1 adds a bright double bell on the landing for a doubled hit, 0 leaves it off

sounds.name: Weakness Bell
sounds.desc: Two quick bright bell strikes, the second an octave up: a hit that just did double damage. Thin and high, so it rides on top of a strike.

pitch.desc: Note of the first bell; the second rings an octave above

ring.desc: How long the bells ring

gap.desc: Time between the two strikes; short is one chime, long is a clear pair

air.desc: Level of the bright breath on the first strike, 0 none

sounds.name: Chip Click
sounds.desc: A single poker chip clicked down: a crisp clay tick with a short ring and a hint of felt underneath.

pitch.desc: Ring frequency of the clay bands: low duller chip, high crisper and brighter

ring.desc: How long the clay ring lasts after the tick

weight.desc: Felt thump under the click: 0 chip on chip, 1 heavy landing on felt

sounds.name: Chip Stack
sounds.desc: Poker chips stacked one by one: uneven clay clicks climbing a little as the stack grows.

chips.desc: How many chips are stacked, one click each

pace.desc: Average time between chips, with some random unevenness

pitch.desc: Ring frequency of the first chip, later chips climb slightly higher

sounds.name: Chips Push All-In
sounds.desc: A pile of chips pushed forward for an all-in: a swelling rattle of clay clicks that ends in a thud and a few settling chips.

length.desc: Duration of the shove before the heap thuds into the pot

chips.desc: How many clay clicks rattle during the shove

pitch.desc: Center frequency of the clicks and settling chips: low duller, high brighter

slide.desc: Sliding noise under the clicks: 0 nearly silent, 1 loud felt hiss

sounds.name: Card Deal
sounds.desc: One card dealt across the table: a flick off the deck, a soft skim over felt and a quiet landing.

reach.desc: Flight time to the seat: a longer skim and a later landing

tone.desc: Brightness of the flick and skim: 0 dark, 1 bright and airy

land.desc: Weight of the landing: 0 barely touches, 1 firm set-down

sounds.name: Deal a Hand
sounds.desc: A hand dealt round the table, one card per seat, each landing a little differently.

cards.desc: How many cards are dealt, one per seat

gap.desc: Time between one card and the next

spread.desc: How much the landing thump pitch differs by seat: 0 all alike, 1 widest

sounds.name: Dice Roll
sounds.desc: A die thrown and tumbling to rest: bounces that close up and soften, then a last rocking tick.

bounces.desc: How many times the die bounces before rocking to rest

length.desc: Time from the first bounce to the last, gaps shrinking inside it

surface.desc: Table it lands on: 0 dull, short felt to 1 bright, ringing wood

sounds.name: Dice Shake
sounds.desc: Dice shaken in a cup: bursts of hard little clacks at each stroke, swelling and fading.

length.desc: Duration of the whole shake

pitch.desc: Scales the clack, tock and rattle pitch: low chunky, high small and sharp

dice.desc: How many dice: more dice, more clacks per stroke

sounds.name: Card Discard
sounds.desc: A card tossed onto the discard pile: a flick, a short flight and a papery landing on the stack.

toss.desc: Flight before the landing: 0 dropped close, 1 tossed far with a longer whoosh

pile.desc: Cards already on the pile: more adds papery ticks and softens the thump

weight.desc: Heft of the landing thump: 0 light, 1 heavy

sounds.name: Card Draw
sounds.desc: A card drawn off the top of the deck: a rising paper rub that ends in a small snap as it comes free.

reach.desc: Length of the drag before the card comes free

tone.desc: Brightness of the rub and snap: 0 dark, 1 bright

snap.desc: Level of the snap as the card clears the deck: 0 faint, 1 crisp

sounds.name: Fan Out Hand
sounds.desc: A hand of cards fanned open: a quick climbing ratchet of paper ticks over a breath of air.

cards.desc: How many cards tick past as the hand opens

length.desc: Time to fan the whole hand open

bright.desc: Frequency of the ticks and air swell: 0 darker, 1 brighter

sounds.name: Card Flick
sounds.desc: A playing card flicked off the deck, or a short fan of them dealt one after another.

count.desc: How many cards are flicked in a row

gap.desc: Time between successive flicks

bright.desc: Snap brightness: 0 dull, 1 bright, each later card a touch brighter

sounds.name: Card Flip
sounds.desc: A card turned face up: a small scrape, a crisp snap at the turn and a light landing.

speed.desc: Pace of the whole gesture: low slow and drawn out, high quick

snap.desc: Strength of the paper snap at the turn: 0 faint, 1 crisp

tone.desc: Brightness of the scrape and snap: 0 dark, 1 bright

sounds.name: Hand Sweep
sounds.desc: A hand of cards swept back into the deck: a quick run of flicks under one swoosh, a dull bump, then a short riffle.

cards.desc: How many cards are swept, one flick each

gap.desc: Time between flicks: short a quick scoop, long a slower sweep

reach.desc: How far the swoosh carries after the last flick, before the deck bumps

riffle.desc: The riffle as the cards slide in: 0 only the bump, 1 a longer, louder ripple

sounds.name: Card Land
sounds.desc: A played card arriving at its spot: a low thunk for the table, a small metal clink for an attachment, a dull pat for the discard pile.

onto.desc: Where it lands: stadium a low thunk, tool a clink, discard a dull pat

weight.desc: Heft of the landing: 0 light, 1 heavy and deeper

tone.desc: Surface color: 0 dull and dark, 1 bright and hard

sounds.name: Card Peek
sounds.desc: A quiet peek under the corner of a face-down card: a soft lift with a few creaks, a held pause, then the corner dropping back.

lift.desc: Time the corner takes to rise: short a quick look, long a careful one

hold.desc: How long the corner stays up before it drops back

creak.desc: The bending of the stiff card: 0 silent, 1 a run of fine creaks

tone.desc: Brightness of the paper: 0 dark, 1 bright

sounds.name: Piece Capture
sounds.desc: One wooden piece knocking another off its square: a sharp clack, then the lost piece skittering away.

pitch.desc: Wood pitch of the clack and of the tocks as the piece skitters away

force.desc: How hard the strike is: louder, brighter clack and a firmer low thump

scatter.desc: How far the taken piece skitters: more tocks, spaced wider apart

sounds.name: Board Piece Move
sounds.desc: A wooden piece slid a little and set down on a board with a hollow, polite tok.

pitch.desc: Wood pitch of the tok, also tinting the drag and click: low big, high small

hollow.desc: Boxiness of the board: 0 dull solid tok, 1 hollow wood-block ring

slide.desc: Drag over the board before set-down, very short values skip the drag sound

sounds.name: Card Place
sounds.desc: A single card set down on the table with a soft pat, felt-dark or wood-bright.

weight.desc: Heft of the pat: 0 light, 1 louder with a deeper thump

tone.desc: Surface color: 0 felt-dark, 1 wood-bright

drop.desc: Height the card falls from: adds a paper tick and a slightly later landing

sounds.name: Card Reveal
sounds.desc: A card slapped down face up, five flavors: a crisp item, a warm supporter, a broad stadium, a clipped tool and a heavy ace with a flash.

kind.desc: Which card: item crisp, supporter warm, stadium broad, tool clipped, ace heavy with a flash

force.desc: How hard the card is slapped down: 0 a gentle lay, 1 a hard slap

tone.desc: Brightness of the slap: 0 dark and padded, 1 bright and papery

ring.desc: How long the extra detail rings (the warm notes, the clink, the flash)

sounds.name: Deck Riffle
sounds.desc: A deck riffled together: a quick ripple of paper ticks, never two quite alike.

gap.desc: Time between card ticks: short a fast ripple, long a slower one

pitch.desc: Base frequency of the paper ticks: low dull, high crisp

sounds.name: Overhand Shuffle
sounds.desc: An overhand shuffle: separate short ripples of paper as chunks drop off the deck, then a pat to square it.

chunks.desc: How many chunks are peeled off the deck

pitch.desc: Base frequency of the paper ripples: low dull, high crisp

square.desc: Closing pat that squares the deck: 0 barely there, 1 firm

sounds.name: Card Slide
sounds.desc: A card slid across the felt: a soft breathy glide that falls away from you or rises toward you.

length.desc: Duration of the glide

pitch.desc: Scales the glide and grit frequencies: low dark, high bright

rise.desc: Glide direction: 0 falls away from you, middle flat, 1 rises toward you

grit.desc: Fine gritty grains on top of the glide: 0 smooth, 1 grainy

sounds.name: Card Tap
sounds.desc: A card turned sideways on the felt with a short paper drag and a soft pat, or, switched off, stood back upright with a lighter settle.

on.desc: 1 turns the card sideways with a firm settle, 0 stands it up with a lighter one

speed.desc: Pace of the turn: low slow and drawn out, high quick

weight.desc: Heft of the settle: 0 barely touches, 1 a firm pat

tone.desc: Brightness of the paper drag: 0 dark felt, 1 bright and papery

sounds.name: Turn Timer Tick
sounds.desc: A quiet wooden clock tick-tock for a turn timer, small enough to repeat every second.

pitch.desc: Frequency of the tick, the tock beat sits lower

tone.desc: Character of each beat: 0 soft wooden knock, 1 crisp click

beats.desc: How many beats play, alternating tick and tock

gap.desc: Time between beats

sounds.name: Card Toss Spin
sounds.desc: A card flicked off and spinning through the air: a fluttering whir that slows, drifts across and ends in a skid and a soft landing.

flight.desc: Time in the air before the landing

spin.desc: How fast it turns at the start: low a lazy flutter, high a quick whir

arc.desc: How far it drifts across the stereo field: 0 straight ahead, 1 wide

tone.desc: Brightness of the air puffs: 0 dark, 1 bright

sounds.name: Table Wash
sounds.desc: A deck mixed with both hands in wide circles on the table: overlapping paper sweeps in each ear and a scatter of fine grit.

length.desc: How long the wash lasts

strokes.desc: How many sweeps the hands make, alternating left and right

grit.desc: Fine paper grit on top: 0 smooth felt, 1 gritty cards

tone.desc: Brightness of the sweeps: 0 dark, 1 bright and airy

sounds.name: Your Turn
sounds.desc: A gentle two-note mallet cue that says it is your move, with a soft tap of a card underneath.

pitch.desc: Frequency of the first mallet note

interval.desc: How far the second note leaps above the first, default a fifth

bright.desc: Mallet hardness: 0 soft and round, 1 brighter with more overtones

ring.desc: How long the notes ring, the first a little shorter

sounds.name: Action Cast
sounds.desc: An action card played: a rising whoosh, a bright snap, a pulse sweeping the table and the card flicked onto the discard pile.

wind.desc: Length of the rising whoosh before the snap: short a flick, long a build-up

flash.desc: Brightness of the snap: 0 a dull pop, 1 a crisp pop with a glass ring

pulse.desc: Level of the pulse sweeping across the table after the snap, 0 none

sounds.name: Trigger Bag Resolve
sounds.desc: Wooden chips knock out one at a time, climbing in pitch, each answered by a small glass ping. For triggered abilities resolving in order.

count.desc: How many chips resolve, each a step higher

gap.desc: Time between chips: short a quick run, long a deliberate one

pitch.desc: Pitch of the first chip; the rest climb from it

ping.desc: The glass ping after each chip: 0 only wooden knocks, 1 clear pings

sounds.name: Banish Shatter
sounds.desc: A card cracking like glass and falling away: a quick crackle, a break that sinks in pitch, grey dust, tinkling shards, a low thump.

shatter.desc: How much the glass crackles and rings before it falls: 0 a quiet crack, 1 a full shatter

fall.desc: How long the dust takes to sink: short a quick drop, long a slow fall

thump.desc: Weight of the low thump as the card settles, 0 none

sounds.name: Banner Raise
sounds.desc: A wide location card sliding in on a low sweep, a banner unrolling in two cloth flaps and a small gold chime for its lore.

slide.desc: Length of the low sweep as the card slides in

cloth.desc: Level of the two cloth flaps as the banner unrolls, 0 none

chime.desc: Level of the small gold chime that follows, 0 none

sounds.name: Card Land
sounds.desc: A card landing damp with a soft pat, beads of ink falling from it, then a warm shimmer opening as it dries. For playing a character.

weight.desc: Heft of the landing pat: 0 light, 1 a deeper thump

beads.desc: How many beads of ink fall off the card after it lands

dry.desc: The shimmer as the card dries: 0 none, 1 a full warm bloom with a glass tip

sounds.name: Chorus Cast
sounds.desc: A character singing a song: a short rising phrase of soft "ah" voices that ends in a glass bell as the song lights up.

pitch.desc: Starting note of the sung phrase, which climbs a major arpeggio

notes.desc: How many notes the phrase climbs before the bell

breath.desc: Airiness of the voices: 0 pure and clear, 1 breathy

shine.desc: Level of the glass bell where the song lights up, 0 none

sounds.name: Chorus Sum
sounds.desc: Singers joining one after another: each card adds a pip and a voice to a growing chord, closed by a bright bell when it adds up.

cards.desc: How many singers join the stack

pitch.desc: Root of the chord that the first singer starts

gap.desc: Time between one singer joining and the next

shine.desc: Level of the closing bell when the threshold is met, 0 none

sounds.name: Duel Clash
sounds.desc: One card lunging at another: a rush, a heavy clunk with a short cold ring, then two dry damage ticks at once, one on each side.

force.desc: Weight of the blow: 0 a light bump, 1 a heavy slam

pitch.desc: Note of the cold ring after the clunk; the second card rings a third above

damage.desc: Level of the two dry damage ticks after the clash, 0 none

sounds.name: Dash Tether
sounds.desc: A fast rising rush into a snap, then a tight string twang: a dash pulled up short by a tether. For Rush and Reckless.

speed.desc: How long the dash builds before the snap: short sudden, long a run-up

snap.desc: Strength of the snap and thump where it arrives: 0 soft, 1 sharp

tension.desc: Note of the tether string: low a slack cord, high a tight wire

sounds.name: Exert Tilt
sounds.desc: A card turned on its side to act, a dimming slide and a low knock, or stood back up, a brightening slide and a thin glass tip.

on.desc: 1 exerts: a dimming slide and low knock; 0 readies: a brightening slide and glass tip

turn.desc: How long the card takes to turn: short a flick, long a lazy tilt

weight.desc: Heft of the knock as the card settles: 0 a whisper, 1 a solid tap

tone.desc: Surface under the card: 0 felt-dark, 1 bright wood

sounds.name: Guard Block
sounds.desc: A solid wooden thud with a short metal ring: a blow stopped by a guard. For a Bodyguard stepping in to take an attack.

pitch.desc: Note of the wooden thud; the metal ring sits well above it

ring.desc: How much the guard rings after the knock: 0 a dry thud, 1 a longer metal ring

weight.desc: Heft of the blow: 0 a light knock, 1 a fuller, harder thud

sounds.name: Hunt Chain
sounds.desc: A ping and quickening ticks lock on to one target, then challengers clash into it one after another, each a step higher, until it shatters.

hits.desc: How many challengers clash into the target before it breaks

pace.desc: Time between clashes: low a rapid chain, high a deliberate one

pitch.desc: Note of the first clash; each later clash rings a step higher

shatter.desc: How loudly the target breaks at the end: 0 a faint tick, 1 a full crackle and fall

sounds.name: Blue Ink
sounds.desc: The Blue ink signature: a marimba arpeggio ticks along with clockwork and lands on a high note, then the gears slow. For planning and building up ink.

pitch.desc: Transposes the whole signature: low and woody, high and glassy

mallet.desc: Hardness of the marimba mallets: 0 round and soft, 1 sharp with more overtones

gears.desc: How many slowing gear ticks follow the landing, 0 none

space.desc: Small room around the signature, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Gold Ink
sounds.desc: The Gold ink signature: three soft plucks climb into a warm pair of bells that glow and ring out. For supportive, kind cards.

pitch.desc: Transposes the whole signature: low and mellow, high and light

glow.desc: Slow warm swell under the bells: 0 dry plucks and bells, 1 a full glow

space.desc: Soft room around the signature, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Green Ink
sounds.desc: The Green ink signature: three dry plucked notes with leafy swishes land in a finger snap and a rustle of leaves. For tricky cards.

pitch.desc: Transposes the whole signature: low and woody, high and perky

snap.desc: The finger snap that lands the signature: 0 hardly there, 1 sharp and bright

leaves.desc: The rustle of leaves that follows: 0 none, 1 a full shower

space.desc: Small room around the signature, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Grey Ink
sounds.desc: The Grey ink signature: three small rivet tinks rise into an anvil clang over a low thud. For armored, resistant cards.

pitch.desc: Transposes the whole signature: low and massive, high and lighter

weight.desc: Thud under the clang: 0 a bare ring, 1 a deep heavy hit

ring.desc: How long the metal rings after the clang

space.desc: Small room around the signature, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Red Ink
sounds.desc: The Red ink signature: a charging riser slams into a brassy stab with a thump and a crack, and a dash trail fades behind. For fast, bold cards.

pitch.desc: Transposes the whole signature: low and menacing, high and urgent

bite.desc: Edge of the brass stab: 0 a rounded blat, 1 a bright snarl

punch.desc: Weight of the thump and crack that land with the stab

space.desc: Small room around the signature, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Violet Ink
sounds.desc: The Violet ink signature: a backwards shimmer swirls upward into a glassy bell that rings with a faint glide back down. For magic and returns.

pitch.desc: Transposes the whole signature: low and eerie, high and bright

swirl.desc: How far the opening glide sweeps: 0 a short lift, 1 a long climb from low

shimmer.desc: Glassiness of the landing bell: 0 nearly a pure tone, 1 bright and metallic

space.desc: Soft room around the signature, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Ladder Climb
sounds.desc: A chain of upgrades: each form slides on with a soft landing and a step higher, the tone thickening, until the last arrives free with gold chimes.

tiers.desc: How many forms stack up, each one step higher and thicker

rise.desc: How far each step climbs: low a gentle stair, high a steep ladder

pitch.desc: Note of the first form; the last form and the chimes are built above it

glass.desc: Level of the glass tick on each step and of the lore chimes, 0 none

sounds.name: Lend Hop
sounds.desc: Two soft mallet blips, the second higher: strength hopping from one card to another. For Support.

pitch.desc: Note of the first blip

step.desc: How far up the second blip hops: a small step to a full octave

gap.desc: Time between the two blips: short a quick hop, long a lazy arc

bright.desc: Mallet hardness: 0 round and muted, 1 woody with a clear tap

sounds.name: Lore Gain
sounds.desc: A small gold star arcing up and landing as a rising run of glass chimes, one more note for each point of lore gained.

lore.desc: Lore gained: each point adds one more rising chime to the run

pitch.desc: First note of the chime run, which climbs from it

shine.desc: Sparkle left hanging over the last chime: 0 clean, 1 a glittering tail

sounds.name: Lore Tick
sounds.desc: A tiny gold glass tick for one point of lore on the meter. Quiet and quick, meant to repeat; raise the pitch as the meter fills.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the tick: low a dull gold, high a thin bright glass

glass.desc: How long the glass rings after the tick: 0 a dry tick, 1 a small chime

sounds.name: Move to Location
sounds.desc: A card hops, slides across a wide location card and settles with a soft landing tick and a faint ring. For moving a character to a location.

pitch.desc: Scales the hop, the brush and the landing: low and heavy, high and light

distance.desc: Length of the slide across the location: a short hop to a long glide

ring.desc: The faint glass ring as it settles: 0 only a soft tick, 1 a clear ring

sounds.name: Pump and Snipe
sounds.desc: A bonus hops to an ally, its strength ticks upward in quick blips, then a twanging shot lands and the target shatters.

pump.desc: How many strength blips count up after the hop

flight.desc: How long the shot zips before it lands; the shatter follows it

shatter.desc: How loudly the target breaks: 0 a faint tick, 1 a full glass crackle and fall

pitch.desc: Note of the bow string; the hop and the strength blips are pitched from it

sounds.name: Quest Pull
sounds.desc: A gentle rising pull, like a tether tugging, ending in a small golden chime. For Adventurous, a card drawn to quest.

pitch.desc: Where the pull starts; it climbs about a sixth

pull.desc: How long the pull takes: short a quick tug, long a slow draw

lore.desc: Level of the small chime at the end: 0 none, 1 clear

sounds.name: Ready Sweep
sounds.desc: A whole row of cards standing up in a rising run of soft wooden ticks as a band of light sweeps across, left to right.

on.desc: 1 tips the row over in a falling run; 0 stands it up in a rising sweep

cards.desc: How many cards in the row

gap.desc: Time between one card and the next: short a ripple, long a slow wave

tone.desc: Brightness of the ticks and the band of light: 0 dark, 1 bright

sounds.name: Resist Plink
sounds.desc: A bright metal tink or two off armor, a small step down, then one dry tick: damage shaved down. For Resist.

pitch.desc: Note of the armor plate: low a heavy plate, high a thin one

chips.desc: How many points the armor chips off, one tink each

drop.desc: The downward blip after the tinks: 0 barely a step, 1 a deep slide

sounds.name: Shift Swell
sounds.desc: One card sliding over another: a reedy swell that rises a fifth, then a thud and a bright glass overtone as it lands.

up.desc: 1 shifts up: a rising swell and a bright landing; 0 comes apart: a sinking swell, a soft tick

pitch.desc: Root of the swell, which climbs or sinks a fifth from it

swell.desc: Length of the swell before the new card lands

land.desc: Weight of the landing: 0 almost none, 1 a firm thud with a bright overtone

sounds.name: Slip By
sounds.desc: A thin, fluttering swish that slides past and fades: an attack missing its mark. For Evasive.

length.desc: How long the pass takes: short a quick slip, long a slow glide

pitch.desc: Height of the swish: low a soft breath, high a thin hiss

flutter.desc: Fluttering grains riding the swish: 0 a smooth pass, 1 busy and ghostly

width.desc: How far it travels across the speakers: 0 stays centred, 1 crosses fully

sounds.name: Slip and Draw
sounds.desc: Two airy attackers sweep past a defender that swings and misses, a swirl bounces it away, small gold chimes pay out and cards flick off the deck.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the swoops, the bounce and the chimes: low a heavy glide, high a thin one

lore.desc: How many small gold chimes the quest pays, each higher than the last

draws.desc: How many cards flick off the deck at the end

ghost.desc: Level of the faint wavering glassy edge on the swoops, 0 plain air

sounds.name: Song Rush
sounds.desc: Two cheap singers tilt and trade a fast, wordless "ahh" run up the scale, then the song fires for free in a bright flare of gold chimes.

notes.desc: How many notes the two voices run up before the song fires

speed.desc: Time per note: low a rapid rush, high a more measured run

vowel.desc: Vowel colour: 0 a closed, dark "oo", 1 an open, bright "ah"

pitch.desc: Note the run starts from; the flare chimes are built above it

sounds.name: Spike Pump
sounds.desc: A quick rising run of bright notes ending in a crack: strength pumped up as the attack begins. For Challenger.

pumps.desc: How many pulses climb, one for each point of strength added

pitch.desc: Note of the first pulse; each one climbs a minor third above the last

crack.desc: The crack and thump that close the run: 0 soft, 1 hard

sounds.name: Surge Drop
sounds.desc: Ink jumps ahead of the curve: quick drips, a swelling rise and a big card landing early with a low ring and a flash of gold.

drips.desc: How many extra ink drips jump into the well before the rise

rise.desc: How long the swell builds before the card lands

weight.desc: Heft of the landing: a louder, longer thump and a longer low ring

pitch.desc: Note of the rise, the landing thump and its ring; lower is deeper

sounds.name: Sweep Clear
sounds.desc: A board wipe: cards stack up quietly, a low swell rolls across the table and crashes, and the characters on the far side break and fall away.

stacks.desc: How many face-down cards slide under before the swell

swell.desc: How long the low swell builds before the crash

crash.desc: Heft of the crash: a louder, longer boom and a bigger burst of glass

fallen.desc: How many characters break and fall after the crash

sounds.name: Ink Token Mint
sounds.desc: A single-use ink token appearing: a small bloop of ink and one bright coin-like tink that chirps upward. For minting a token worth one ink.

pitch.desc: Note of the tink: low a fuller coin, high a tiny bright one

ring.desc: How long the tink rings out

bloop.desc: The upward ink bloop before the tink: 0 none, 1 a clear bubble

sounds.name: Ink Token Pop
sounds.desc: A single-use ink token spent: a soft falling pop, a glassy tick and a few small crumbs of glass tumbling away. For paying one ink once.

pitch.desc: Start pitch of the pop before it falls: low a round bubble, high a small one

crumbs.desc: The small glass crumbs after the pop: 0 none, 1 a clear tumble

sounds.name: Under Slide
sounds.desc: Ink dripping to pay, then a card sliding softly under another and settling with a small click. For Boost.

cost.desc: How many ink drips are paid before the card slides: 0 none

slide.desc: How long the card takes to slide under

tone.desc: Paper color: 0 dull and dark, 1 crisp and bright

sounds.name: Vanish Dust
sounds.desc: A tiny lock-on tick, then a card dissolving into falling, glittering dust. For Vanish.

pitch.desc: Where the glittering dust starts: low a soft sigh, high a thin sparkle

length.desc: How long the dissolve takes to thin out

grit.desc: Fine specks of dust in the fade: 0 smooth, 1 busy

sounds.name: Victory Burst
sounds.desc: The win: a quick rising run of glass bells that opens into a full chord, a burst of sparkle and a warm swell underneath.

pitch.desc: Root of the arpeggio and the chord it opens into

notes.desc: How many bells run up the arpeggio before the chord opens

sparkle.desc: Level of the rush of sparkle at the burst, 0 none

space.desc: Reverb mix, from a dry run to a wide bright hall

sounds.name: Ward Bubble
sounds.desc: A glassy bubble forming and ringing, then a tink and a tiny crackle as something bounces off and shatters. For Ward.

pitch.desc: Start note of the bubble before it bends up; the glass rings well above it

ring.desc: How long the glass rings after the bubble forms: 0 a quick pop, 1 a lingering ring

shatter.desc: Fine crackle of the thing that bounces off and breaks: 0 only a tink, 1 a clear spray

sounds.name: Well Drip
sounds.desc: A bead of ink falling into a dark well: a soft glassy plink, a low bubble in the pool and two ripples. For inking a card.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the falling bead: low a heavy blot, high a small bead

glass.desc: Glassy tip on the plink: 0 plain liquid, 1 a clear ringing edge

pool.desc: The dark pool answering: 0 a bare plink, 1 a deep bubble with ripples

sounds.name: Wide Payoff
sounds.desc: A bonus pays off: three soft tilts, a muted landing and a shimmer, then small gold glass chimes climb and stack, one per lore point scored.

stars.desc: How many lore chimes stack up, each higher than the last

pitch.desc: Note of the first chime; the others climb above it

gap.desc: Time between chimes: low a quick run, high a spaced climb

space.desc: Room around the chimes, from dry to a wide shimmer

sounds.name: Arcane Charge
sounds.desc: Energy gathering: a glowing swell climbs in pitch with shimmering overtones and ends in a ready ping.

length.desc: Climb time: how long the swell rises before the ready ping

pitch.desc: Base note: the climb rises to three times it, the ping lands at six times

shimmer.desc: Loudness of the airy high hiss rising with the swell, faint to prominent

space.desc: Room reverb mix, from dry to a lush wash

sounds.name: Curse Hex
sounds.desc: A sinister low toll with a sour interval, a sagging drone and creeping whispers. For debuffs and dark spells.

pitch.desc: Root note: the saw drone sits here, the tolling bells an octave up

dread.desc: Loudness of the sour tritone bell that clashes with the toll

whisper.desc: Loudness of the breathy whisper bursts, faint to upfront

space.desc: Dim room reverb mix, from dry to murky

sounds.name: Enchant
sounds.desc: A harp-like run of plucked notes over a glowing pad, closing on a bell. For enchanting an item.

pitch.desc: First harp note: the run, the glowing pad and the closing bell are tuned from it

notes.desc: How many plucked strings climb the run; more notes reach higher and last longer

speed.desc: Gap between plucks: short for a fast glissando, long for a slow strum

glow.desc: Loudness of the soft pad humming under the harp

space.desc: Room reverb mix, from dry to a lush wash

sounds.name: Fire Spell
sounds.desc: A rushing fireball: a warm thump at the cast, a roar that swells and fades, and crackling embers.

heat.desc: How far the roar's lowpass opens: low a muffled rumble, high a bright blaze

length.desc: How long the roar lasts, with the embers spread across it

crackle.desc: Number of popping embers, from a few to a dense crackle

weight.desc: Loudness of the low thump at ignition

sounds.name: Healing Shimmer
sounds.desc: A warm chord that swells and blooms with a few falling sparkles. For healing, a blessing or a buff.

pitch.desc: Chord root; the falling sparkles are tuned above it

swell.desc: Chord fade-in time: short blooms fast, long swells slowly; sparkles start later too

sparkle.desc: How many sparkles fall, and how loud the airy hiss under them is

space.desc: Warm room reverb mix, from a light touch to a lush wash

sounds.name: Ice Spell
sounds.desc: A crystalline freeze: a glassy ring over a frosty hiss, then icy shards tinkling away downward.

pitch.desc: Glass ring note; the shards start an octave above and fall below it

shards.desc: How many icy shards tinkle down after the ring

frost.desc: Loudness of the frosty high hiss under the glass

space.desc: Bright room reverb mix, from dry to a glittering wash

sounds.name: Lightning Bolt
sounds.desc: A bright crack of electricity that forks into crackling arcs and rolls away as low thunder.

bright.desc: Start pitch of the falling zap in the strike: lower is duller, higher sharper

crackle.desc: How many forked arcs crackle after the strike

rumble.desc: Loudness of the rolling thunder underneath

thunder.desc: How long the thunder rolls on after the strike

space.desc: Small room reverb mix, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Portal Open
sounds.desc: A swirling gateway tears open: a resonant vortex whirls up, then a deep shimmering chord settles.

size.desc: Build time: how long the vortex whirls before the gateway opens

pitch.desc: Root of the throb, the opening thump and the shimmering chord

swirl.desc: Vortex loudness, plus how fast and hard the throb pulses

space.desc: Big room reverb mix, from dry to cavernous

sounds.name: Potion Bubble
sounds.desc: A bubbling cauldron of glassy bloops with a faint magical glimmer. For potions, brewing and alchemy.

bubbles.desc: How many bloops rise from the cauldron

pitch.desc: Base bloop pitch, each bubble lands randomly around it; glimmers sit far above

span.desc: Time the bubbling spreads over, and the length of the gurgle bed

glimmer.desc: Number and loudness of the faint high magic pings

sounds.name: Magic Sparkle
sounds.desc: A rising twinkle of bright notes over a breath of shimmer, with a little room around it.

notes.desc: How many notes climb the major arpeggio

pitch.desc: First note of the arpeggio; the rest climb from it

gap.desc: Time between notes: short a quick flurry, long a slower twinkle

shimmer.desc: Loudness of the airy high hiss under the notes; none at the bottom

space.desc: Small room reverb mix, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Spell Cast
sounds.desc: Magic gathered and let go: a quick rising swirl, then a bright bell bloom opening in a soft room.

pitch.desc: Bell bloom note; the swirl rises from an octave below to meet it

gather.desc: Wind-up time of the rising swirl before the bell blooms

bloom.desc: Brightness of the bell: adds upper partials and a sparkle of hiss

space.desc: Soft room reverb mix, from dry to a lush wash

sounds.name: Teleport
sounds.desc: A vanishing rush upward, a beat of silence, then a soft bell where you reappear.

pitch.desc: Start note of the vanishing rush, which shoots up to six times higher

gap.desc: Silence between vanishing and reappearing

reach.desc: Raises the arrival rush and landing bell relative to the departure pitch

space.desc: Room reverb mix, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Arc Zap
sounds.desc: A short electric arc: a snap, a rough flickering buzz and a spit of crackle. For an electric border lighting up, a plasma effect or a spark between two things.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the buzz: low a heavy mains drone, high a thin electric whine

length.desc: How long the arc holds before it dies

crackle.desc: How much it spits: 0 a clean buzz, 1 a dense shower of crackle

snap.desc: Hardness of the opening strike: 0 a soft start, 1 a sharp crack

sounds.name: Circuit Pulse
sounds.desc: A bright chirp zips along a circuit trace, kicking up a notch at each corner, and lights a node at the end with a glassy ring. For energy flowing through a circuit diagram.

pitch.desc: Where the first chirp starts; it rises more than an octave along each run

turns.desc: How many right-angle corners the pulse takes, 0 for a straight run

length.desc: How long the pulse takes to run the whole trace

glow.desc: Size of the glassy ring where the pulse arrives: 0 a faint tick, 1 a bright ring

sounds.name: Confetti Pop
sounds.desc: A hollow party-popper pop followed by a thinning shower of paper flutters and a few bright glints. For celebrations, wins and milestones.

pops.desc: How many poppers go off, a few hundredths of a second apart

length.desc: How long the paper takes to come down

pitch.desc: Pitch of the hollow thump in the pop: low a big cannon, high a small popper

glitter.desc: How many bright glints twinkle through the shower, 0 none

sounds.name: CRT Power
sounds.desc: An old tube screen turning on with a thump and a climbing whine, or off with a collapse to a single dot. For retro boot screens and screen-off effects.

on.desc: Direction: 1 powers on with a thump and a climbing whine, 0 collapses to a dot

pitch.desc: Top of the high-voltage whine; the dot pip sits lower

thump.desc: Weight of the low degauss thump and the wobbling ring under it

length.desc: How long the whine takes to climb on power-on, or the collapse takes on power-off

sounds.name: Identity Disc
sounds.desc: A spinning disc is thrown, whirs away with a falling pitch, curves back rising and is caught with a clack. For a projectile that returns, like a boomerang.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the whir as it passes by; it falls away and rises back around this

distance.desc: How long the disc flies out before it turns; the way back takes the same time

spin.desc: How fast the disc spins: a slow flutter to a fast buzz

width.desc: How far it travels across the stereo field: 0 straight ahead, 1 out wide to one side and back

sounds.name: Firework
sounds.desc: A shell whistles up, bursts with a flash and a thump, then crackles and glitters as the embers fall. For celebrations and finales.

height.desc: How long the shell whistles upward before it bursts

boom.desc: Weight of the burst: 0 a light pop, 1 a deep rolling thump

crackle.desc: How much the embers crackle and glitter after the burst, 0 none

space.desc: How big the night sky sounds, from dry to a wide echoing wash

sounds.name: Foil Sheen
sounds.desc: A bright hollow sweep with a breath of air and a few tiny glints, like light sliding across foil. For a hover, a tilt or a shiny card being revealed.

pitch.desc: Where the sheen starts; it climbs about a fifth as it passes

length.desc: How long the sheen takes to sweep across

breath.desc: Soft air under the sweep: 0 almost none, 1 a clear breathy whoosh

shine.desc: How many tiny glints sparkle along the sweep: few to many

sounds.name: Gear Whir
sounds.desc: A little set of gears spinning up and winding down: meshing ticks over a rising and falling servo whine. For settings cogs, machinery and mechanical loaders.

length.desc: How long the gears spin

teeth.desc: How many ticks the gears make: few a slow clunking turn, many a fine whir

pitch.desc: Resting pitch of the servo whine, which climbs about four times higher at full spin

whine.desc: Level of the servo whine under the ticks, 0 leaves only the gears

sounds.name: Glitch Burst
sounds.desc: A digital hiccup: a tiny chirp stuck on repeat, then another, smeared left and right and crushed to grit. For a screen glitching or an image corrupting.

harsh.desc: Grit: 0 a mostly clean stutter, 1 a harsh crushed one with louder static between the slices

pitch.desc: Pitch of the first stuck chirp; later slices jump up to an octave away

slices.desc: How many different frames get stuck before the picture recovers

split.desc: How far the three copies drift apart in pitch and timing: 0 a single voice, 1 a wide smear

sounds.name: Grid Sweep
sounds.desc: Deep sub pulses under a hollow rising wash that ends on a glass ping at the horizon. For a neon grid scrolling into view or a retro-futuristic scene opening.

pitch.desc: Note of the sub pulses; the wash is tuned two octaves above

length.desc: How long the wash takes to rise before the ping

pulses.desc: How many sub pulses throb under the wash

bright.desc: How far the sweep opens: 0 stays dark and hollow, 1 climbs to a bright shimmer

sounds.name: Hologram On
sounds.desc: A shimmering sweep that stutters into a glassy chord as a projection appears, or breaks up and drifts away as it switches off. For a hologram or a screen image materializing.

on.desc: Direction: 1 the projection appears, 0 it breaks up and disappears

pitch.desc: Note of the glassy chord the shimmer settles on

stutter.desc: How broken the lock-on is: 0 one smooth sweep, 1 many short digital slices

length.desc: How long the shimmer takes to build, or to break up

sounds.name: Liquid Drip
sounds.desc: A single drop plinks into a pool and ripple rings spread out behind it. Thin for water, thick for wax or syrup. For liquid loaders, ripples and dripping effects.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the drop: low a big heavy drop, high a tiny bright one

rings.desc: How many ripple rings follow the drop, each quieter than the last

thick.desc: How thick the liquid is: 0 thin water, 1 slow wax or syrup with a lower, rounder drop

space.desc: Small room reverb mix, from dry to wet

sounds.name: Blob Morph
sounds.desc: A gooey wobbling tone that swells up (or shrinks back down) as a shape morphs, with a few soft bloops along the way.

up.desc: 1 swells and brightens as the shape grows, 0 shrinks and darkens

length.desc: How long the morph takes

pitch.desc: Low note of the morph; the other end sits about an octave and a quarter above

wobble.desc: How fast the goo wobbles: low a slow slosh, high a quick shiver

goo.desc: Richness of the tone: 0 smooth and round, 1 buzzy and thick

sounds.name: Neon Strike
sounds.desc: A neon sign or bad bulb stuttering on: rough buzzing strikes that grow longer, then a steady electric hum. For a sign switching on or a failing light.

flickers.desc: How many stuttering strikes before the tube holds

pitch.desc: Pitch of the buzz and the hum: low a deep transformer drone, high a thin whine

buzz.desc: Roughness of the strikes: 0 soft and smooth, 1 harsh with a rasp and sharp cracks

length.desc: How long the flickering takes before the hum settles

sounds.name: Rocket Launch
sounds.desc: Ignition, a deep rumble and a roar that opens up as a rocket climbs away and fades. For launches, deploys and blast-offs.

length.desc: How long the engine burns before the rocket is away

power.desc: Weight of the engine: 0 a thin hiss, 1 a deep shuddering rumble

bright.desc: How far the roar opens up: 0 stays muffled, 1 ends in a hard bright blast

crackle.desc: Level of the sparks crackling at ignition and through the roar, 0 none

sounds.name: Scramble Decode
sounds.desc: A shower of random blips that narrows onto one note and locks in with a glassy ring. For text unscrambling, a redaction lifting or a code being cracked.

pitch.desc: The note the scramble settles on

chars.desc: How many scrambled characters flicker by: a sparse patter to a dense shower

length.desc: How long the scramble lasts before the note locks

lock.desc: How long the final note rings: 0 a quick blip, 1 a long glow

sounds.name: Glass Shatter
sounds.desc: A sharp crack and a burst of splinters, then shards tinkling to the floor. For breaking glass, cracked screens and things smashed apart.

crack.desc: Hardness of the first impact: 0 a soft break, 1 a sharp crack with a thump

shards.desc: How many shards land and tinkle after the break

fall.desc: How long the shards keep falling and landing

pitch.desc: Pitch of every ring: low thick pane glass, high thin small glass

sounds.name: Signal Tear
sounds.desc: A worn tape losing tracking: the tone sags and wobbles, noise bands race down the screen, then it locks back. For old TVs, VHS and a failing signal.

tear.desc: How badly the signal slips: 0 a light wobble, 1 a deep sag with several heavy noise bands

tone.desc: Pitch of the picture tone before it sags

length.desc: How long the slip lasts before the signal locks again

snow.desc: Level of the static snow and speckle under the tear

sounds.name: Vortex Spiral
sounds.desc: Air circling faster and faster around you as the pitch climbs, or falls on the way in. For spiral transitions, vortex pulls and tunnel zooms.

up.desc: 1 spirals up and out with a rising pitch, 0 is pulled in with a falling one

length.desc: How long the spiral takes

turns.desc: How many times it circles from side to side

pitch.desc: Low end of the sweep; the other end sits three octaves above

swirl.desc: Focus of the air: 0 a broad rush, 1 a thin whistling ring

sounds.name: Soft Alert Siren
sounds.desc: A gentle two-tone siren that swoops between notes: a warning that gets attention without startling.

pitch.desc: Lower of the two siren notes

cycles.desc: How many up-and-back siren cycles play

interval.desc: Gap between the two siren notes, narrow to wide

rate.desc: Time per swoop: short a hurried alarm, long a slow wail

tone.desc: Lowpass cutoff: low a muffled siren, high a brighter, edgier one

sounds.name: Blaster Bolt
sounds.desc: A heavy plasma shot: a gritty falling snarl with a bright crack on top and a thump underneath.

pitch.desc: Start pitch of the falling snarl and its FM layer

length.desc: Duration of the falling snarl and its FM layer

grit.desc: Saturation on the snarl, from mild to heavily distorted

weight.desc: Loudness of the low thump underneath

sounds.name: Data Stream
sounds.desc: A rapid patter of tiny bitcrushed ticks and chirps, like data pouring through a channel.

ticks.desc: How many ticks pour through, sparse to dense

length.desc: Time the ticks spread over, and the length of the hiss bed

pitch.desc: Center pitch of the ticks

spread.desc: Pitch scatter of the ticks, from one pitch to a wide random spread

grit.desc: Bitcrush depth: low cleaner, high coarser and more lo-fi

sounds.name: Facility Klaxon
sounds.desc: A growling industrial alarm horn in three blasts: a steady buzzing tone with a mechanical rattle, ringing in a concrete hall. For lockdowns, breaches and red alerts.

pitch.desc: Horn note; the rattle always runs at a quarter of it

blasts.desc: How many blasts sound, with a 0.4 s breath between them

length.desc: Length of each blast

rasp.desc: Growl: the rattle depth, the noise rasp and the drive, from a clean horn to a ragged one

space.desc: How much of the concrete hall rings around and after the horn

sounds.name: Hologram Flicker
sounds.desc: A glassy digital tone that stutters and drops out as a projection flickers, with static in the gaps.

pitch.desc: Base note of the glassy FM tone

flickers.desc: How many bursts the tone stutters into before it settles

glitch.desc: Instability: more bitcrush, wider pitch wander and louder static in the gaps

length.desc: Time the flicker sequence spreads over; the bursts stretch with it

sounds.name: Laser Zap
sounds.desc: A bright falling pew for a laser shot. Fire it once, or in a quick burst of up to four.

pitch.desc: Start pitch of the pew

drop.desc: How far each pew falls: low a short dip, high a deep plunge

shots.desc: How many pews in the burst, each a touch lower than the last

rate.desc: Time between shots in a burst; no effect on a single shot

edge.desc: Square-wave bite: low a smoother sine-like pew, high a buzzier one

sounds.name: Power Down
sounds.desc: A machine spinning down: a falling whine closes under a slowing patter of ticks and ends in a soft clunk.

length.desc: Time the machine takes to wind down before the clunk

pitch.desc: Machine's base pitch, tuning the falling whine and the ticks

ticks.desc: How many ticks slow to a stop under the whine

bright.desc: Starting brightness of the closing lowpass, muted to bright

sounds.name: Power Up
sounds.desc: A machine spinning up: accelerating ticks climb into a rising whine that locks on at full power.

length.desc: Spin-up time before the lock-on chime

pitch.desc: Base pitch: tunes the climbing whine, the ticks and the lock-on chime

ticks.desc: How many accelerating ticks play during the spin-up

bright.desc: How far the lowpass opens by the end: duller to brighter whine

sounds.name: Robot Chirp
sounds.desc: A quick burst of FM chirps that swoop up and down like a small, expressive droid.

pitch.desc: Base voice pitch; chirps wander within about an octave of it

chirps.desc: How many chirps the droid says

mood.desc: Chance each chirp swoops up: low glum and falling, high perky and rising

speed.desc: Average chirp length: short a quick chatter, long slower syllables

sounds.name: Scanner Sweep
sounds.desc: A narrow beam sweeping up and back with a wobble, ending on a two-blip confirm.

pitch.desc: Bottom of the sweep; the beam climbs two octaves and the blips sit above

sweeps.desc: Number of beam passes, alternating up and back, before the confirm blips

length.desc: Duration of each sweep

wobble.desc: Depth of the fast tremolo on the beam, steady to warbling

sounds.name: Shield Hum
sounds.desc: A throbbing energy hum that swells in as a shield powers up, then settles into a slow pulse.

pitch.desc: Base pitch of the hum; a square sits an octave under, a thin whine high above

pulse.desc: How fast the hum throbs, slow pulse to rapid flutter

bright.desc: How far the resonant lowpass opens, and the level of the thin top whine

length.desc: How long the shield hums before fading

sounds.name: Terminal Blip
sounds.desc: A quick run of bitcrushed computer beeps, like a console printing a readout or acknowledging a command.

pitch.desc: First beep's pitch; later beeps pick scale notes up to an octave above

count.desc: How many beeps in the run

speed.desc: Time between beeps

grit.desc: Bitcrush depth: low cleaner beeps, high crunchier with choppier tails

sounds.name: Warp Jump
sounds.desc: An engine whine winds up, then the ship leaps: a stretched streak and a deep thump as it vanishes.

charge.desc: Wind-up time of the engine before the jump

pitch.desc: Engine base pitch, tuning the rising whine and the zip at the jump

boom.desc: Loudness of the deep thump as the ship vanishes

tail.desc: Length of the falling noise streak after the jump

sounds.name: Cathedral Choir
sounds.desc: A hushed choir swelling on a minor chord under a stone vault, the vowel slowly opening. For a gothic menu, a crypt or a solemn reveal.

singers.desc: How many voices: few is a lonely consort, many a full choir

vowel.desc: What they sing: a hum or an oo opening out, or a held ah or oh

space.desc: How much of the stone vault you hear, from a chapel to a cathedral

sounds.name: Cello Drone
sounds.desc: Low cellos holding a bare fifth, swelling in and out of the dark. For a quiet threat, a long walk down a corridor, or a menu that broods.

players.desc: Players per note: one cello, or a section

grit.desc: Bow pressure: 0 a smooth glassy tone, 1 a rough, digging scrape

shiver.desc: 1 bows tremolo (the nervous shiver), 0 long smooth bows

sounds.name: Doom Drum
sounds.desc: A single enormous drum blow that booms through a hall. For a boss entrance, a title card or the moment everything goes wrong.

pitch.desc: Pitch of the big drum; the timpani sits a fifth under it

mallet.desc: How hard the stick: 0 a soft felt thud, 1 a cracking blow

space.desc: How big the hall answers

sounds.name: Dread Descent
sounds.desc: A tone that keeps sinking and never reaches the bottom: pure, endless dread. For a fall into the dark, a nightmare or a slow loss of control.

speed.desc: How fast it sinks: slow creeping dread to a steep plunge

rise.desc: 1 climbs for ever instead (rising panic), 0 sinks

edge.desc: From pure sine tones to a reedy, organ-like buzz

length.desc: How long it goes on

sounds.name: Organ Minor Swell
sounds.desc: A pipe organ swelling on a minor chord over a deep pedal note. For a gothic title, a haunted mansion or a dramatic reveal.

stops.desc: Registration: soft flutes, the principal chorus, or full organ

tremulant.desc: The slow wobble of the wind: 0 steady, 1 deep and unsettling

space.desc: How much of the nave you hear

sounds.name: Aurora Pad
sounds.desc: A slow, wide, glowing chord that swells and sways like curtains of light, with a thin glitter above. A dreamy bed for a night sky.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

pitch.desc: Root of the chord, the other notes follow it

glow.desc: How many bright upper notes and how much glitter join the chord: 0 plain and warm, 1 lit up

drift.desc: How far the chord sways and swells: 0 nearly still, 1 rolling slowly across the field

sounds.name: Cave Drips
sounds.desc: Slow drips falling in a damp stone chamber, each one ringing in the echo, over a low draft of air.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

drips.desc: How many drips fall during the bed

pitch.desc: Scales drip pitch: low heavy drops, high small bright ones

cave.desc: Chamber echo: 0 shorter and drier, 1 longer and wetter

sounds.name: Distant Thunder
sounds.desc: A storm miles away: a muffled crack and a long low rumble that rolls and fades out.

length.desc: Total duration of the rumble and its rolls

distance.desc: How far the storm is: 0 near with a loud crack, 1 far, darker, no crack

rolls.desc: How many later rolls re-light the rumble after the first

sounds.name: Fire Crackle
sounds.desc: A hearth or campfire: a soft roar of flame with random snaps, pops and the odd log settling.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

crackle.desc: Density of snaps and pops, and how often a log settles

roar.desc: Level of the flame roar and its flicker swells: 0 nearly silent, 1 full

tone.desc: Crackle brightness: 0 dull and woody, 1 bright and sharp

sounds.name: Forest Birds
sounds.desc: Morning birdsong in the trees: tweets, trills and whistles from near and far over a faint breeze.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

activity.desc: How many bird phrases sing: 0 sparse, 1 busy

pitch.desc: Scales all the birdsong pitch: low deeper, high shriller

trill.desc: Share of phrases that are fast warbling trills rather than tweets or whistles

sounds.name: Grid Hum
sounds.desc: The clean electric hum of a vast digital grid: a pure throbbing tone with a glassy sheen and tiny data ticks crossing it. For cyber scenes.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

pitch.desc: Fundamental of the hum, the harmonics follow it

sheen.desc: Level of the glassy resonant sheen above the hum: 0 none, 1 clear

traffic.desc: How many tiny data ticks cross the grid: 0 none, 1 busy

sounds.name: Lava Bubbles
sounds.desc: Thick warm bubbles rising slowly and popping softly over a low simmer of heat, like a lava lamp. Fades in and out.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

bubbles.desc: How many big slow bubbles rise during the bed

depth.desc: Scales bubble pitch: low thick slow ones, high small light ones

heat.desc: Level of the warm simmer under the bubbles: 0 faint, 1 full

sounds.name: Night Crickets
sounds.desc: A warm summer night: a few crickets chirping in runs from different places in the dark, over cool still air.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

crickets.desc: How many crickets are chirping, spread across the field

pitch.desc: Scales every cricket pitch: low and mellow, high and thin

pace.desc: How fast the chirps repeat: slow and cool to quick and warm

sounds.name: Ocean Surf
sounds.desc: Waves building and breaking on a beach, each with a hiss of foam, over a low swell. Fades in and out.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

period.desc: Time between waves, longer also makes each wave build slower

foam.desc: Level of the foam hiss after each crest: 0 none, 1 full

depth.desc: Low sea swell under the waves: 0 nearly gone, 1 heavy

sounds.name: Rain
sounds.desc: Rain on leaves and puddles, from a drizzle to a steady downpour. Fades in and out.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

rate.desc: Rain intensity: 0 light drizzle to 1 steady downpour, more drops and plinks

tone.desc: Brightness of the hiss, drops and plinks: 0 dull, 1 bright

sounds.name: Room Tone Hum
sounds.desc: A quiet indoor bed: electrical hum with its buzzing harmonics over a breath of ventilation hiss.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

pitch.desc: Mains hum frequency, with a soft sine an octave above it

buzz.desc: Brightness of the sawtooth buzz: 0 dull hum, 1 bright buzzy harmonics

sounds.name: Sand Pour
sounds.desc: Fine sand pouring in a soft steady hiss, thinning to a last few grains and a quiet settle. Good under an hourglass or a timer running down.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, settle included

flow.desc: Thickness of the stream: 0 a thin trickle, 1 a full pour

grain.desc: Size of the grains: 0 fine and airy, 1 coarse and gritty

settle.desc: Level of the soft shush as the pile settles at the end: 0 none

sounds.name: Snow Hush
sounds.desc: Snow falling on a windless night: a soft muffled hush, clumps sliding off branches and faint ice glints. A calm winter-scene bed.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

hush.desc: Level of the muffled blanket of air: 0 barely there, 1 full

slides.desc: How many soft clumps of snow slide off a branch

glints.desc: How many faint ice glints sparkle in the cold air

sounds.name: Space Drone
sounds.desc: A slow, deep drone for a ship or a void: a dark pad that opens up, with a faint shimmer far above.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

pitch.desc: Root frequency of the drone, harmonics and shimmer follow it

tone.desc: How far the slowly opening filter reaches: 0 dark, 1 brighter

shimmer.desc: Level of the high trembling shimmer: 0 none, 1 full

sounds.name: Starfield Pad
sounds.desc: A thin airy pad under a sky of stars: soft twinkling notes ring out across a wide, quiet field. For space and night scenes.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

stars.desc: How many stars twinkle during the bed

pitch.desc: Scales the whole sky: low calm and round, high thin and bright

glow.desc: Level of the airy pad under the stars: 0 faint, 1 full

sounds.name: Storm Roar
sounds.desc: Being inside a big storm: a deep wide roar of wind and sheeting rain with a low wail running through it. For a gale, tornado or downpour.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

fury.desc: Size of the storm: 0 a hard blow, 1 a full gale with a heavier, brighter roar

rain.desc: Level of the steady sheet of rain hiss: 0 none, 1 heavy

howl.desc: Level of the wail through the roar: 0 none, 1 clearly audible

sounds.name: Synthwave Drive
sounds.desc: A night drive as a texture: a steady bass pulse, a slow glowing chord and the rush of the road, with no tune. For retro neon scenes.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

pitch.desc: Pitch of the pulsing bass note, the chord follows it

pulse.desc: How fast the bass pulses: a slow cruise to a fast drive

glow.desc: Brightness and level of the held chord: 0 dark and quiet, 1 open and bright

road.desc: Level of the rushing air of the road: 0 none, 1 full

sounds.name: Wind Gusts
sounds.desc: An open-air wind bed: steady air with slow gusts rolling through and a faint whistle. Fades in and out.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

gust.desc: Strength of the slow passing gusts: 0 steady air only, 1 strong gusts

pitch.desc: Scales air, gust and whistle pitch at even level: low deep, high thin

whistle.desc: Thin whistle through a gap: 0 none, 1 clearly audible

sounds.name: Zen Breath
sounds.desc: A slow breath in and out over the soft wobbling hum of a singing bowl. For focus, calm and winding down.

length.desc: Total duration of the bed, fades included

pitch.desc: Pitch of the bowl, its upper tones follow it

breath.desc: Level of the slow breath: 0 only the bowl, 1 a clear breath

cycle.desc: Length of one whole breath, in and out: a quick light breath to a long slow one

sounds.name: Alert Sting
sounds.desc: Short minor stabs and a long tense chord with a sub thump, for danger, a boss entrance or a hard warning.

tempo.desc: Higher plays the stabs and the chord faster and shorter

stabs.desc: Number of short minor stabs before the long chord

edge.desc: Bit-crush amount: 0 light 8-bit grit, 1 coarser and harsher

sounds.name: Defeat Jingle
sounds.desc: A falling four-note sad-brass wah for a lost round: three short steps down and one long sagging note.

tempo.desc: Higher plays the four notes faster and shorter, lower drags them out

droop.desc: Sag and wobble on the last note: 0 steady, 1 a deep wobbling slide down

tone.desc: Brightness of the wah filter: 0 dark and muffled, 1 brassier

sounds.name: Short Fanfare
sounds.desc: Three stabs and a long chord on synth brass: an announcement or a proud arrival in two seconds.

tempo.desc: Higher plays the stabs and the final chord faster and shorter

brass.desc: How far each note's filter opens: 0 a mellow horn, 1 a bright brassy blat

weight.desc: Level of the low octave root and the cymbal wash on the final chord

sounds.name: Intro Logo Sting
sounds.desc: A rising sweep that opens into a warm, ringing major-seventh chord with a glint on top. A calm logo reveal.

tempo.desc: Higher shortens the rising sweep so the chord lands sooner

shine.desc: Level of the high bell glint over the chord

space.desc: Reverb mix: low keeps the chord close, high a long washy room

sounds.name: Level Complete
sounds.desc: A warm plucked arpeggio climbing into a ringing bell chord. For finishing a stage, not a whole game.

tempo.desc: Higher climbs the arpeggio faster and lands the chord sooner

sparkle.desc: Lifts the top bell and the airy high shimmer at the landing

space.desc: Reverb mix over everything, from dry to roomy

sounds.name: Menu Confirm Melody
sounds.desc: Two to four quick rising notes with an echo, for pressing Start or confirming a menu choice.

notes.desc: How many rising notes play, always ending on the high tonic

speed.desc: Higher plays the run faster; the final held note keeps its length

echo.desc: Level and feedback of the trailing echo: 0 dry, 1 a longer trail

sounds.name: Mystery Sting
sounds.desc: Two hanging bell tones a tritone apart over a dark swell. For a clue, a twist or a door that should not open.

tempo.desc: Higher brings the second bell in sooner and swells the pad quicker

eerie.desc: Opens the bells' FM clang, wobbles the pad and adds a high hiss

space.desc: Reverb mix of the big dark room, from close to cavernous

sounds.name: Ta-da
sounds.desc: A cheerful two-chord reveal: a quick staccato hit and a bright held chord with a sparkle on top.

tempo.desc: Higher brings the held chord in sooner and quickens the glissando
